stories.title: AEW Redemption and Road to All In London
stories.tldr: AEW held its first-ever Redemption pay-per-view on July 26, 2026 in Montreal, setting up multiple matches for All In at Wembley Stadium in August. The show featured Willow Nightingale winning the Women's World Championship while battling depression, an awkward segment with Mick Foley that was later explained as a miscommunication, and an incident where Daniel Garcia slapped fans' phones out of their hands, though Jon Moxley helped resolve the situation positively. Tony Khan expressed optimism about AEW's future and provided injury updates on talents like Mistico.

stories.title: Kairi Sane Free Agency and AEW Interest
stories.tldr: Kairi Sane officially became a free agent after her WWE 90-day non-compete period expired and has drawn interest from multiple wrestling companies. She recently hired veteran agent Barry Bloom, who represents several top AEW stars, sparking speculation about her next destination. However, as of the latest reports, Sane remains unsigned and is actively evaluating her options before making her next career move.

stories.title: Mike Bailey vs Kyle Fletcher AEW International Title
stories.tldr: Mike Bailey won a 6-Way Ladder Match at AEW Redemption to earn a shot at Kyle Fletcher's AEW International Championship at Grand Slam: Mexico on August 5th. Bailey has been vocal about his disdain for the Don Callis Family, calling it a "pyramid scheme" and accusing Don Callis of illegal financial practices. Meanwhile, Fletcher is dealing with internal tension within the Callis Family after a confrontation with Kazuchika Okada during a recent tag team match.

stories.title: AEW Rebel Heart Campaign for ALS Research
stories.tldr: AEW announced a special "Rebel Heart Dynamite" episode on September 9 from Athens, Georgia to honor wrestler Rebel (Tanea Brooks), who was diagnosed with ALS in March 2026. The event will feature Rebel's appearance and benefit I AM ALS and Team Gleason Foundation, with AEW donating proceeds and selling merchandise with 100 percent of profits going to these organizations.

stories.title: Tony Khan Comments on AEW Video Game
stories.tldr: AEW President Tony Khan expressed interest in developing another video game following the release of "Fight Forever" over three years ago. Rather than creating another traditional console wrestling game, Khan indicated the company wants to explore multiple gaming platforms, including mobile options similar to their existing casino and management games. Khan emphasized the importance of learning from their first gaming venture and waiting for the right opportunity without rushing the project.

stories.title: Anna Jay Shoulder Injury Update
stories.tldr: Anna Jay is currently sidelined with a shoulder injury and is consulting multiple doctors to determine the best course of action for her recovery. She recently re-signed with AEW and clarified that she has only suffered two injuries during her time with the company, despite claims to the contrary. Her tag team partner Tay Melo has requested her release from AEW, which will be granted soon.

stories.title: Willow Nightingale TBS Championship Injury
stories.tldr: Willow Nightingale suffered an AC sprain in her right shoulder during a TBS Championship defense against Red Velvet in May, forcing her to vacate the title and miss the Owen Hart Cup Tournament. Though surgery wasn't required, the injury's severity made it impossible for her to fulfill championship duties. She has since recovered and returned to in-ring competition, winning the AEW Women's World Championship at AEW Redemption.

stories.title: WWE SummerSlam 2026 Card and Coverage
stories.tldr: WWE SummerSlam 2026 takes place this weekend on August 1-2 at U.S. Bank Stadium in Minneapolis, streaming exclusively on ESPN Unlimited and Netflix internationally. The two-night event features major championship matches including CM Punk defending the Undisputed WWE Championship against Cody Rhodes, Roman Reigns defending the World Heavyweight Championship against Seth Rollins, and Oba Femi facing Brock Lesnar in a Hell in a Cell match. ESPN is providing extensive multi-platform coverage throughout the week, including special activations like the Danhausen-themed "Very Nice, Very Evil SummerSlam Freeze Tour" ice cream truck.

stories.title: WWE RAW July 27, 2026 Coverage
stories.tldr: WWE RAW on July 27, 2026, delivered a go-home show for SummerSlam from Los Angeles featuring major storyline developments including Roman Reigns and Seth Rollins having a heated personal confrontation that ended in violence, Raquel Rodriguez winning her first singles title by capturing the Women's Intercontinental Championship, and boxer Ryan Garcia joining The Judgment Day stable by attacking Joe Hendry during a musical segment with Danhausen.

stories.title: Mike Santana Ring Name Change to Cruz Montana in WWE NXT
stories.tldr: Former TNA World Champion Mike Santana made his WWE NXT debut on July 21, appearing silently after Tony D'Angelo retained the NXT Championship against Naraku. He officially confirmed his new ring name as Cruz Montana on July 27, revealing that the name honors his late father who passed away six years ago and represents his personal journey through adversity to greatness.

stories.title: Raquel Rodriguez Wins Women's Intercontinental Championship
stories.tldr: Raquel Rodriguez won the WWE Women's Intercontinental Championship on the July 27 episode of Monday Night Raw, defeating Sol Ruca in the main event. The match featured interference from both Rodriguez's Judgment Day teammates and IYO SKY, with Roxanne Perez ultimately preventing Ruca from hitting her finisher, allowing Rodriguez to connect with the Tejana Bomb for the victory. This marks Rodriguez's first main roster singles title despite her four-plus year tenure and six Women's Tag Team Championship reigns.

stories.title: Human Monies on a Pole Stipulation Added to Danhausen vs Dominik Mysterio Match
stories.tldr: WWE has added a Human Monies on a Pole stipulation to the Danhausen vs. Dominik Mysterio match at SummerSlam 2026 Night Two after a chaotic segment on the July 27 episode of Raw. The stipulation came about when Ryan Garcia attacked both Danhausen and Joe Hendry during an in-ring concert, leading to Judgment Day's interference. Danhausen proposed the unique match stipulation to Adam Pearce backstage, who approved it to settle the ongoing dispute over the money Danhausen has been holding.

stories.title: Sheamus Life After WWE Exit
stories.tldr: Sheamus has officially departed WWE after 19 years with the company and is enjoying his newfound free time, reconnecting with family in Ireland and Paris while remaining in excellent physical condition. The Celtic Warrior is reflecting positively on his career despite never winning the Intercontinental Championship, and he's named several current WWE stars he believes are future main eventers, including Oba Femi and Ilja Dragunov, whom he wished he could have faced before his exit.

stories.title: Nikki Bella AEW Coach for WWE Return
stories.tldr: Nikki Bella has revealed that AEW/ROH wrestler Aaron Solo has been coaching her during her comeback from ankle surgery, helping prepare her for her in-ring return at WWE SummerSlam 2026. Solo previously worked with Brie Bella and Bryan Danielson and has conducted multiple training sessions with Nikki before her six-woman tag team match. Nikki indicated this comeback feels different due to her renewed confidence and edgier mindset, and she plans to wind down her wrestling career by the end of 2027.

stories.title: Ryan Garcia Joins The Judgment Day on WWE RAW
stories.tldr: WBC welterweight champion Ryan Garcia made a surprise appearance on WWE RAW on July 27 at the Intuit Dome in Inglewood, California, where he attacked Joe Hendry during a concert segment and aligned himself with The Judgment Day. Garcia smashed a guitar over Hendry's back, allowing Dominik Mysterio and JD McDonagh to join in the assault before celebrating alongside the faction.

stories.title: Vince McMahon and WWE Lawsuit Officially Closed
stories.tldr: The civil lawsuit filed by former WWE employee Janel Grant against Vince McMahon and WWE in January 2024 has been officially closed and moved to private arbitration. Judge Sarah F. Russell of the US District Court of Connecticut ordered the case closed on July 27, 2026, after all parties filed a stipulation of dismissal with prejudice, meaning Grant cannot refile the suit. The case involved allegations of sex trafficking and abuse during Grant's employment with WWE.

stories.title: LA Knight Nearly Responds to Mark Henry Criticism
stories.tldr: LA Knight revealed he recorded an angry video response to Mark Henry's criticism during his first NXT run but deleted it before posting, deciding instead to prove Henry wrong through his work. The two later discussed the moment on Off The Ropes, where Henry admitted he had been hypercritical of Knight but came to respect him for handling the criticism maturely and ultimately becoming a main-event star.

stories.title: Becky Lynch Reveals Seth Rollins SummerSlam Plan
stories.tldr: Becky Lynch revealed that she convinced WWE to have Seth Rollins wear street clothes instead of wrestling gear for his SummerSlam surprise cash-in. Lynch explained that appearing in gear would have immediately tipped off fans that his knee injury was fake, compromising the shock value of the moment. Her advice helped make one of SummerSlam's biggest surprises work exactly as intended.

stories.title: WWE Trademark Filings for New Ring Names
stories.tldr: WWE filed a trademark application for the ring name "Cruz Montana" on July 27 with the United States Patent and Trademark Office. The filing covers professional wrestling entertainment services and performances. Industry speculation suggests the name may be intended for Mike Santana, a former two-time TNA World Champion who recently debuted on WWE NXT after his TNA contract expired.

stories.title: Otis Written Off WWE Television
stories.tldr: Otis has been written off WWE television indefinitely after suffering a brutal chair attack from Austin Theory on the July 27 episode of Monday Night RAW. The assault came after a tag team match where Alpha Academy lost to The Vision, with Maxxine Dupri's distraction playing a key role in setting up the devastating double powerbomb and chair shot. The angle significantly raises the stakes heading into SummerSlam while leaving Akira Tozawa to carry the Alpha Academy banner alone.

stories.title: AJ Styles Reflects on Hardcore Match
stories.tldr: AJ Styles recently revealed that genuine backstage tension with Kid Kash significantly intensified their 2004 Street Fight in NWA-TNA, with the real-life friction translating into an exceptionally physical match. While Styles and Kash didn't get along behind the scenes, they maintained professionalism to ensure neither competitor was seriously injured. Their rivalry continued until March 2005, when Styles retained his X-Division Championship, cementing their feud as a cornerstone of TNA's early X-Division history.

stories.title: Liv Morgan Women's World Champion Milestone
stories.tldr: Liv Morgan has reached the 100-day mark as WWE Women's World Champion, a milestone she celebrated on social media despite not yet defending the title since winning it at WrestleMania 42 in April. Her first title defense will come at SummerSlam against IYO SKY, the Queen of the Ring winner who defeated Morgan in the tournament final before challenging her for the championship.

stories.title: Ryan Reynolds Meets WWE Hall of Famer at SDCC
stories.tldr: Ryan Reynolds went undercover as Deadpool at San Diego Comic-Con, mingling with fans and cosplayers without security or handlers. During his incognito visit, he met WWE Hall of Famer Sergeant Slaughter and later crashed Marvel Studios' Hall H panel as a fake fan named "Ricky." Reynolds celebrated the encounter and the 10-year anniversary of the first Deadpool film by thanking all the fans and cosplayers he met during the convention.

stories.title: Val Venis Viral Attitude Era Moment
stories.tldr: Val Venis revived his famous Attitude Era adult film star gimmick during a recent independent wrestling appearance in New Jersey, complete with his signature suggestive pelvic taunt directed at the commentary table. FireStar Wrestling announcer Chris Riddle responded with a humorous social media post that quickly went viral, joking "That's it. I'm straight." in reaction to Venis' over-the-top antics. The moment highlights how Venis' decades-old character continues to generate reactions during his current independent circuit run following his comeback match in late July.

stories.title: Becky Lynch WWE Hiatus Explanation
stories.tldr: Becky Lynch has been absent from WWE television since June and recently explained her hiatus on the Off The Ropes podcast, suggesting that stepping away reminds fans and WWE leadership of her value to the company. Lynch stated that her absence serves as a demonstration of what the product looks like without her, implying that her return will be met with appreciation from audiences who realize how much she contributes to making the programming exciting and worthwhile.

stories.title: WWE Potentially Expanding SmackDown Programming
stories.tldr: WWE broadcast personality Cathy Kelley revealed during a podcast appearance that she participated in a meeting with USA Network representatives several months ago to discuss expanding programming following Friday Night SmackDown. With SmackDown now running two hours, the network has an additional hour to fill and is exploring content that would maintain WWE viewership while incorporating different entertainment elements adjacent to wrestling. No official announcement has been made regarding what form this potential new programming might take.

stories.title: Stephanie Vaquer Women's World Title Loss Timing
stories.tldr: Stephanie Vaquer lost the WWE Women's World Championship to Liv Morgan at WrestleMania 42 after holding it for 210 days, and she has revealed it was the perfect time for the title change. The former champion explained that her body needed a break after years of nonstop work, and she has been off WWE programming since April 27 due to a reported second-degree high ankle sprain.

stories.title: AJ Styles New WWE Backstage Role
stories.tldr: AJ Styles has taken on a new backstage coaching role at WWE's Performance Center, where he is taking over for one of the existing coaches. The WWE Hall of Famer discussed his new position on his Phenomenally Retro podcast, expressing his genuine enjoyment in mentoring younger talent and helping them develop their in-ring skills.

stories.title: Dragon Lee on AJ Styles Final Title Run
stories.tldr: Dragon Lee recently opened up about his tag team championship run with AJ Styles on RAW, expressing gratitude for how the WWE Hall of Famer pushed him to the next level. Lee reflected on being part of Styles' final title run and shared that the team had pitched the name "Phenomenal Dragons" but didn't have time to fully develop it before Styles' unexpected retirement.

stories.title: CM Punk SummerSlam Retirement Timeline
stories.tldr: CM Punk says health will be the sole determining factor in when he retires from WWE, with the 47-year-old currently feeling better than ever as he prepares to defend his Undisputed WWE Championship against Cody Rhodes at SummerSlam 2026. Punk has no set retirement timeline and plans to continue wrestling until his body forces him to stop, citing improved recovery efforts and the business's ability to accommodate proper training regimens. The two will headline night one of the two-night event in Minneapolis on August 1, with Roman Reigns facing Seth Rollins for the World Heavyweight Championship on night two.

stories.title: Joe Tessitore Praises Oba Femi
stories.tldr: WWE commentator Joe Tessitore has praised rising star Oba Femi, comparing his magnetic presence to that of Brock Lesnar ahead of their Hell in a Cell match at SummerSlam on August 1. Tessitore highlighted how quickly Femi has established himself as a top star, noting that "the air changes when he enters an arena" much like it does with Lesnar. The 2026 King of the Ring winner is expected to face Lesnar in what may be their final encounter, with a victory potentially solidifying Femi as wrestling's next major attraction.

stories.title: WWE SummerSlam Danhausen Ice Cream Truck
stories.tldr: WWE and ESPN are launching a Danhausen-themed ice cream truck in Minneapolis during SummerSlam weekend from July 30 to August 2. The truck will operate across multiple locations including Downtown East Commons Park, Nicollet Mall, the Minneapolis Convention Center, and U.S. Bank Stadium, offering Danhausen-branded frozen treats, photo opportunities, and giveaways. This promotional push comes just before Danhausen competes in his first SummerSlam match against AAA Mega Champion Dominik Mysterio on the event's second night.

stories.title: WWE Club WWE Launch
stories.tldr: WWE officially launched Club WWE, a premium membership program designed to enhance fan engagement through exclusive content, early ticket access, merchandise, and rewards. The membership costs $99 annually and includes perks like a welcome kit for founding members, members-only merchandise drops, behind-the-scenes content, and a rewards points system. International expansion is planned for the future.

stories.title: JBL Defends Triple H on Bron Breakker
stories.tldr: JBL defended Triple H's recent comments about Bron Breakker's WWE presentation, agreeing that the rising star should forge his own identity rather than rely on the legendary Steiner family name. JBL highlighted how previous second-generation wrestlers like Charlotte Flair and Cody Rhodes successfully carved their own paths, and explained that using a different surname gives Breakker an easier route to establish himself without the burden of living up to legendary predecessors.

stories.title: Bron Breakker World Heavyweight Champion Potential
stories.tldr: AJ Styles has questioned WWE's booking decisions regarding Bron Breakker's push toward the World Heavyweight Championship, arguing the talented Raw star should already be in the title picture rather than competing in the Tag Team Championship match at SummerSlam. Styles praised Breakker's abilities and recent heel work with The Judgment Day, expressing frustration that the company hasn't capitalized on his star potential by giving him a heavyweight championship opportunity.

stories.title: Danhausen CM Punk Cody Rhodes Live Event
stories.tldr: Danhausen attempted to play peacemaker between CM Punk and Cody Rhodes following their match in Bakersfield on July 26th, 2026, but both wrestlers unexpectedly kissed him on the lips. Punk joked about the memorable moment, saying he would never forget Bakersfield as the crowd reacted to the unusual encounter.

stories.title: WWE RAW Search Interest Analysis
stories.tldr: WWE Raw's Google search interest has declined 3% over the last 90 days compared to the previous period and is down 10% year-over-year, a notable drop as the company heads into SummerSlam. While the Netflix debut naturally caused some casual viewer fatigue after six to nine months, the recent episodes have failed to generate the level of intrigue that followed major storylines like CM Punk's championship win and Cody Rhodes versus Sami Zayn. Current feuds including Roman Reigns versus Seth Rollins and Brock Lesnar versus Oba Femi have not captured audience interest in the same way.

stories.title: WWE RAW Ticket Distribution and Attendance
stories.tldr: WWE RAW is taking place tonight from the Intuit Dome in Inglewood, California, with 11,675 tickets distributed as of the latest update. This number exceeds the year-to-date average for WWE events at 11,124 tickets, and walk-up sales are expected to increase the total further. The show will feature several marquee segments including a final face-to-face between Roman Reigns and Seth Rollins before SummerSlam.

stories.title: WWE RAW Start Time July 27 2026
stories.tldr: WWE RAW takes place tonight from the Intuit Dome in Inglewood, CA, with the broadcast starting at 8pm Eastern on Netflix. The card features Roman Reigns and Seth Rollins in a face-to-face confrontation ahead of SummerSlam, a weigh-in between Oba Femi and Brock Lesnar for their Hell in a Cell match, and Sol Ruca defending her Women's Intercontinental Title against Raquel Rodriguez among other matchups.

stories.title: John Cena Classic Tournament Announcement
stories.tldr: John Cena announced the John Cena Classic tournament at WWE Backlash 2026, featuring competitors from RAW, SmackDown, and NXT with fan voting determining the winner. During an interview at San Diego Comic-Con 2026, Cena expressed excitement about the event while maintaining loyalty to WWE by withholding specific details, promising fans an excellent tournament experience.

stories.title: PFL New York Fight Card
stories.tldr: PFL New York takes place Friday, July 31, 2026, at UBS Arena in Belmont Park with the early card starting at 4:00 PM ET and main card at 7:00 PM ET. The card features undefeated Usman Nurmagomedov defending his Lightweight World Title against 13-0 Archie Colgan in the main event, with 15-0 Dakota Ditcheva facing Denise Kielholtz in the co-main event. The promotion is showcasing two of its biggest stars on the same card for a significant New York fight night.

stories.title: TNA Faction Reunites at WrestleCon
stories.tldr: The Main Event Mafia, a legendary TNA faction consisting of Scott Steiner, Booker T, Sting, Kurt Angle, and Kevin Nash, will reunite for the first time at WrestleCon in Minneapolis on Friday, July 31 over SummerSlam weekend. Fans can purchase group photos with all five legends for $280, marking the first-ever group appearance of the original members together.

stories.title: Karen Jarrett Regrets TNA Kurt Angle Storyline
stories.tldr: Karen Jarrett has expressed regret about participating in a 2009 TNA storyline that blurred the lines between her real-life divorce from Kurt Angle and her on-screen reunion with Jeff Jarrett. Both Karen and Jeff discussed the angle on his podcast, with Karen noting she didn't anticipate how seriously fans would take it, while Jeff claimed he felt pressured into the story by Dixie Carter, though he ultimately doesn't regret it for providing his family financial stability.

stories.title: TNA iMPACT Highest Viewership on AMC
stories.tldr: TNA iMPACT achieved its highest viewership on AMC with 307,000 viewers on July 23, 2026, marking a significant increase from the previous week's 286,000 viewers. The episode also improved its demo rating to 0.05 in the 18-49 age group, up from 0.03 in June, signaling growing audience interest in the promotion's Thursday night programming.

stories.title: Rey Mysterio Comments on AAA Growth
stories.tldr: Rey Mysterio praised AAA's remarkable growth following WWE's acquisition of the lucha libre promotion, noting it fulfills a long-held vision to showcase Mexican wrestling globally. With Mattel now producing AAA action figures and a WWE x AAA Worlds Collide event scheduled, the brand is experiencing rapid expansion and integration with WWE's main roster programming.

stories.title: Val Venis Comes Out of Retirement
stories.tldr: Val Venis, the WWE Attitude Era star, ended his retirement after nearly four years away from professional wrestling to compete in an ISPW Legends of Wrestling Night event in Wildwood, New Jersey. At 55 years old, Morley faced Rico Gold in his first match since April 2022 but came up short in the contest. Despite the loss, Morley delivered a respectful promo acknowledging Gold's victory and the significance of the moment.

stories.title: Paramount-WBD Buyout Process Stalls
stories.tldr: The Paramount-Skydance acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery has stalled after a state coalition lawsuit resulted in a judge temporarily halting the deal. Dave Meltzer discussed on Wrestling Observer Radio how the postponement is costing Paramount significantly, with the company now facing $6.5 million daily penalties to WBD starting in October if the deal isn't completed, raising questions about whether the merger will ultimately be approved given Paramount's total company valuation is only $9 billion.

stories.title: Jon Moxley at Wrestling Revolver Silence of the Slams
stories.tldr: Jon Moxley answered Joe Alonzo's open challenge at Wrestling Revolver's Silence of the Slams in Nashville, delivering a masterclass in storytelling. After Alonzo cut a promo about being disrespected by management, Moxley arrived and defeated him cleanly with a Paradigm Shift and Death Rider, creating an entertaining undercard match that never jeopardized Moxley's upcoming AEW appearance.

stories.title: Title Changes July 27 Wrestling History
stories.tldr: July 27th has been a historically significant date for professional wrestling title changes, with approximately 271 notable championships switching hands on this date throughout history. Major champions crowned on July 27th include Stan Hansen (three times between 1988-1990), Kurt Angle (WWE Title in 2003), and Low-Ki (ROH Title in 2002). The most recent title change occurred in 2024 when Dustin Rhodes, Marshall Von Erich, and Ross Von Erich won the ROH World 6-Man Tag Team Titles.

stories.title: Man Like DeReiss’ Mania week grannies in movie talks
stories.tldr: Producer Nick Barton, known for films like Calendar Girls and The Full Monty, is developing a movie based on the heartwarming true story of English wrestler Man Like DeReiss befriending four Welsh grandmothers who met him on a plane headed to WrestleMania week in Las Vegas. The grandmothers were initially confused by the wrestling spectacle but formed a genuine connection with DeReiss that has now caught the attention of major producers.

stories.title: Zilla Fatu To Face Amazing Red At HOG High Intensity
stories.tldr: Zilla Fatu will defend the HOG Crown Jewel Championship against Amazing Red on August 7 at HOG High Intensity in Jamaica, Queens. Red earned this title shot by winning the 2025 Matt Travis Memorial Battle Royal and has chosen to challenge the dominant champion directly rather than exploit any advantage. The match pits Red's decades of experience and legacy against Fatu's current dominance and destructive power.

stories.title: National Hulk Hogan Day Celebration Set For Florida Hooters Locations This Weekend
stories.tldr: Hulk Hogan's legacy will be celebrated across Florida this weekend as Real American Beer and Hooters partner for a special National Hulk Hogan Day event. Fans are invited to visit participating Hooters locations in Tampa, Brandon, and Clearwater on Saturday, August 1, to enjoy food, drinks, and raise a toast with Hogan's Real American Beer brand to honor the WWE Hall of Famer.

stories.title: Road To Back In The Saddle: Brayden Lee On Teaching By Day And Becoming EMERGE Champion
stories.tldr: Brayden Lee, a high school teacher by day and professional wrestler by night, has become the reigning EMERGE World Champion after eight years with the promotion. Rising from his early days helping set up events as a trainee, Lee credits his versatility in wrestling styles, intelligent game planning, and unwavering loyalty to EMERGE for his success in capturing the promotion's top title. Despite occasional appearances for AEW, Lee has remained committed to EMERGE, viewing it as home and the promotion that gave him his first opportunity.

stories.title: Backstage News On WWE Possibly Spoiling Plans For Interim Women’s World Champion
stories.tldr: WWE scrapped previously planned matches for SummerSlam, including Charlotte Flair vs. Jade Cargill and Tiffany Stratton's title defense, due to the introduction of an Interim WWE Women's Championship Ladder Match created following Rhea Ripley's injury. The winner of the ladder match had been scheduled for one of the cancelled singles matches, creating a conflict that forced WWE to remove both bouts from the card.

stories.title: Ricky Saints Addresses Absence from WWE SummerSlam Card
stories.tldr: Ricky Saints remains hopeful of securing a spot on the WWE SummerSlam card despite currently not being advertised for the two-night event. The SmackDown star expressed optimism during an interview, noting there is still time for WWE to add him to the stacked lineup. With less than a week before SummerSlam, Saints made a final pitch for inclusion while praising the company's decision to expand the event to two nights.

stories.title: Backstage Update On WWE Hall Of Fame 2027 Plans For WrestleMania 43 Weekend In Saudi Arabia
stories.tldr: WWE is expected to hold its 2027 Hall of Fame ceremony in Saudi Arabia as part of WrestleMania 43 weekend, marking a historic first for the event. Saudi Arabia has expressed strong interest in hosting the ceremony and elevating it by inviting government dignitaries alongside traditional Hall of Fame guests. There are no plans to skip the Hall of Fame ceremony next year, with the event now positioned to become a more prestigious international affair.

stories.title: WWE Star Planning To Retire At The End Of 2027
stories.tldr: WWE Hall of Famer Nikki Bella has announced plans to retire from in-ring competition at the end of 2027, approximately a year and a half from now. The veteran wrestler, who returned to WWE in 2025 after a seven-year absence, is focused on finishing her career on her own terms while continuing to elevate women's wrestling and enjoy time with her twin sister Brie during what remains of her active career.

stories.title: Michael Cole Opens Up About Replacing Jim Ross In WWE
stories.tldr: Michael Cole recently discussed his journey as Jim Ross's successor in WWE, explaining how he spent a decade struggling to find his own voice while being constantly compared to the legendary commentator. Cole credited Vince McMahon and Kevin Dunn's belief in him for eventually helping him discover where he belonged, ultimately learning that the key difference was bringing genuine emotion to his commentary.

stories.title: WWE Legend Says They’re “Coming Close To The End”, Vows To “Break Rules” If Necessary
stories.tldr: WWE legend Nikki Bella has set an end date for her in-ring career, targeting the end of 2027 to wrap things up on her own terms. Following her return at the 2025 Royal Rumble and recent comeback from an ankle injury, Bella vowed to "break rules" if necessary to ensure her final chapter matches her creative vision. She emphasized her commitment to empowering women's wrestling while challenging herself and fighting for what she believes in during her remaining time in the company.

stories.title: Dana White reveals how long Conor McGregor is out for
stories.tldr: Conor McGregor suffered a torn ACL and meniscus in his right knee during his UFC 329 fight against Max Holloway, sidelining him for a minimum of 12 months. Dana White confirmed the timeline after the recent Zuffa Boxing event, while McGregor explained via social media how the leg injury impacted his performance during the bout. The Irish fighter still has one fight remaining on his UFC contract when he returns.

stories.title: Can’t Knock The Hustle: Dwayne Johnson, A Possible Bruised Ego & The Return Of The Rock
stories.tldr: A wrestling news editor criticizes Dwayne Johnson's poorly designed wig in the live-action Moana film, arguing that Disney's $250 million budget should have allowed for better quality. The movie is underperforming at the box office with only $43.1 million in its opening weekend, compared to Moana 2's $139.8 million, suggesting a notable decline in Johnson's star power as a box office draw in recent years.

stories.title: Maya World TBS Championship
stories.tldr: Maya World won the AEW TBS Championship at Redemption on July 26, 2026, defeating Hikaru Shida in an upset victory on her 24th birthday. World, who reached the Owen Hart Foundation Tournament finals just weeks after her brother's tragic death, capitalized on a distraction to roll up Shida and claim her first major AEW title. Following the win, World expressed interest in facing ROH Women's World Champion Athena at All In 2026 while continuing her tag team partnership with Hyan.

stories.title: AEW Redemption Media Scrum and Coverage
stories.tldr: AEW held its inaugural Redemption pay-per-view on July 26, 2026, in Montreal, featuring Kenny Omega retaining his World Championship against Kevin Knight before turning on Will Ospreay of the Death Riders in a shocking post-match angle. While the event produced several title changes including Willow Nightingale winning the Women's Championship and Speedball Mike Bailey earning an International Championship match, critical reception was mixed with concerns about whether the five-hour show was necessary ahead of All In in August.

stories.title: Willow Nightingale Injuries and Achievements
stories.tldr: Willow Nightingale defeated Thekla at AEW Redemption on July 26, 2026, to capture the AEW Women's World Championship, becoming the first-ever Women's Grand Slam Champion in company history. The victory came after recovering from an AC sprain that forced her to vacate the TBS Championship and miss the 2026 Owen Hart Cup Tournament. Nightingale will now defend her title against Mercedes Mone at AEW All In on August 30 in London.

stories.title: Andrade El Idolo AEW National Championship
stories.tldr: Andrade El Idolo defeated Mark Davis to win the AEW National Championship at the Redemption pay-per-view on July 26, 2026, in Montreal. The victory marked Andrade's first singles title in AEW after breaking away from the Don Callis Family. The match featured his signature spots and his ongoing gimmick of interacting with fans at ringside, including four mystery women whose identities were later revealed as independent wrestlers.

stories.title: Other AEW Redemption Matches
stories.tldr: AEW Redemption 2026 took place on July 26 from Montreal, featuring Kyle Fletcher retaining the International Championship against Bandido in a hard-fought match, the Young Bucks defeating Jon Moxley and Will Ospreay despite internal team conflict, the Conglomeration retaining the Trios Championship, and the Dogs winning a chain match with help from the Death Riders, while a tribute to the legendary Rougeau family was interrupted by the Don Callis Family.

stories.title: Mike Bailey Post-Redemption
stories.tldr: Speedball Mike Bailey won a six-way ladder match at AEW Redemption in his hometown of Montreal, earning a shot at Kyle Fletcher's AEW International Championship at Grand Slam on August 5. Beyond his in-ring victory, Bailey made waves with comments criticizing WWE's past hiring practices for overlooking wrestlers from Quebec who didn't fit a specific mold, while also expressing continued respect for his former tag team partner Kevin Knight despite their storyline split.

stories.title: Kenny Omega vs Will Ospreay and AEW All In World Title
stories.tldr: Kenny Omega retained the AEW World Championship against Kevin Knight at Redemption in Montreal, but the post-match angle stole the show. Will Ospreay broke away from the Death Riders by refusing to suffocate Omega with a plastic bag, leading to an official World Championship match between the two at AEW All In in London on August 30. However, Omega attacked Ospreay after their handshake, adding intrigue to their upcoming title match.

stories.title: AEW All In London Championship Matches
stories.tldr: Adam Copeland and Christian Cage successfully retained the AEW World Tag Team Championship at AEW Redemption on July 26, 2026, defeating Claudio Castagnoli and PAC of the Death Riders despite being dominated for most of the match. Following their victory, the Young Bucks confronted the champions in the ring, leading to an official announcement that they will challenge for the titles at AEW All In: London on August 30 at Wembley Stadium.

stories.title: AEW Podcast Network Launch
stories.tldr: Tony Khan has confirmed that AEW's podcast network is still in active development and coming soon, though no launch date has been announced. The update came during an AEW Redemption post-show media scrum just days after WWE launched WWE Radio on SiriusXM, though Khan emphasized the podcast network project has been in the works for quite some time and wasn't a reaction to WWE's new venture.

stories.title: Adam Cole ALS Ice Bucket Challenge
stories.tldr: Adam Cole accepted the ALS Ice Bucket Challenge after being nominated by Britt Baker and Rebel, completing the challenge while delivering his signature catchphrase. Cole nominated three of his Undisputed Era teammates—Roderick Strong, Kyle O'Reilly, and Bobby Fish—to continue the campaign. The challenge has seen renewed popularity in the wrestling community following Rebel's ALS diagnosis earlier this year.

stories.title: Anna Jay Shoulder Injury
stories.tldr: Anna Jay has confirmed she is sidelined with a shoulder injury and is currently out from AEW competition. The 28-year-old wrestler is consulting multiple doctors to determine the severity of the injury and the best course of treatment. She recently re-signed with AEW and has not competed since June 6, 2026.

stories.title: AEW Video Games Future
stories.tldr: Tony Khan has confirmed that AEW remains interested in returning to video game development despite the underperformance of Fight Forever. Rather than rushing into another project, Khan emphasized the company learned valuable lessons from its first attempt and is exploring different gaming platforms and genres. AEW plans to announce future gaming projects much closer to their release date rather than years in advance.

stories.title: AEW Dynamite July 29 Card
stories.tldr: AEW Dynamite on July 29th from Detroit, Michigan will feature the AEW World Trios Championship match between defending champions The Conglomeration and The Demand, along with a celebration for newly crowned AEW Women's World Champion Willow Nightingale. The Young Bucks will appear for an interview ahead of their August 30th All In title challenge against current AEW World Tag Team Champions Adam Copeland and Christian Cage.

stories.title: David Arquette AEW Segment
stories.tldr: David Arquette revealed on "Buused Open Radio" that he was set to appear in an AEW segment with Chris Jericho, but the plans fell through without explanation. Despite not being officially notified of the cancellation, Arquette was so eager to appear that he flew to the show anyway, only to discover he was no longer part of the card, which he found embarrassing.

stories.title: AEW PPV Schedule
stories.tldr: AEW has announced three major pay-per-view events scheduled for 2026, including AEW All In at Wembley Stadium in London on August 30, AEW All Out in Chicago on September 26, and AEW Full Gear in Phoenix on November 14. All three events will be available through multiple streaming platforms including MyAEW, HBO Max, Amazon Prime, YouTube, PPV.com, and Fubo, as well as traditional cable and satellite outlets.

stories.title: Buddy Matthews AEW Return Tease
stories.tldr: Buddy Matthews, the former AEW World Trios Champion sidelined since February 2025 due to an ankle injury suffered at Grand Slam Australia, is teasing an imminent return to in-ring competition. His cryptic social media posts suggest he has received medical clearance and is waiting for the right moment to make his presence felt again, with fans speculating a potential appearance at the Redemption pay-per-view and a possible House of Black reunion following Aleister Black's recent departure from WWE.

stories.title: CM Punk and AEW Collision Control
stories.tldr: CM Punk was given unprecedented creative control over AEW Collision's roster during his time with the company, able to exclude anyone he didn't want on his show including company executives. This accommodation came after a backstage investigation following his first altercation, though both investigating parties recommended AEW release him. Since joining WWE in November 2023, Punk has reportedly been a positive locker room presence with no backstage issues reported.

stories.title: Tony Khan Blood and Guts Naming
stories.tldr: AEW owner Tony Khan revealed that the name "Blood & Guts" for the promotion's marquee recurring event was actually inspired by a dismissive comment made by Vince McMahon during a 2019 investor call. McMahon stated that WWE was "not like those blood and guts guys," a quote Khan found so compelling that he decided to build an entire event around it. The event has since become one of AEW's signature television spectacles, with the 2025 iteration featuring both Men's and Women's Blood & Guts matches for the first time.

stories.title: AEW Redemption Card Changes
stories.tldr: AEW's Redemption 2026 pay-per-view in Montreal has undergone significant card changes due to injuries, scheduling conflicts, and matches being completed earlier than planned on recent episodes of Dynamite. Seven matches were either canceled or rescheduled, including Kenny Omega's world title defense, several championship bouts, and tag team encounters, as wrestlers dealt with injuries or international tournament commitments.

stories.title: Tay Melo AEW Release
stories.tldr: Tay Melo has been granted her release from AEW after requesting it following the June 6 episode of Collision, according to AEW President Tony Khan. Melo shared a cryptic Instagram post about a dying pink tree that she and her husband saved by replanting it in the ground, drawing apparent parallels to her situation in the company. The post emphasizes gratitude for where she came from while acknowledging the need to find where she truly belongs.

stories.title: Sheamus WWE Departure
stories.tldr: Sheamus has confirmed his departure from WWE after 19 years with the company, stating that "some circumstances came up" but declining to discuss specific details. The Celtic Warrior is currently enjoying time off, spending quality time with family in Ireland and Paris, and plans to go by the ring name S. Farrelly moving forward if he continues wrestling.

stories.title: John Cena Hollywood and WWE Projects
stories.tldr: John Cena is transitioning into Hollywood with starring roles in upcoming projects like "Matchbox: The Movie," where he performed practical stunts including jumping off a building under director Sam Hargrave. Meanwhile, Cena remains committed to his WWE legacy through the long-awaited John Cena Classic event, which he hopes to deliver before the end of the year, while maintaining a rigorous fitness routine to ensure longevity and quality of life as he approaches 50.

stories.title: AJ Styles WWE Retirement and Commentary
stories.tldr: AJ Styles has retired from in-ring competition and transitioned into a backstage coaching role at the WWE Performance Center, where he mentors younger talent and takes pride in helping develop the next generation of wrestlers. Beyond his new coaching duties, Styles has been actively involved in WWE tryouts by personally recommending independent wrestlers he believes have potential, while also sharing career advice drawn from his own journey through TNA and beyond.

stories.title: Bayley WWE Live Events
stories.tldr: Bayley made her return to WWE action at a live event in Stockton, California, competing in a triple threat match for the Women's Intercontinental Championship against Lyra Valkyria and Sol Ruca. Despite recent speculation that she had been written off television following a loss to Valkyria at Saturday Night's Main Event, Bayley attacked Valkyria at the live event, suggesting their feud will continue. Her contract is reportedly set to expire at the end of the year, leaving her future with the company uncertain.

stories.title: Kairi Sane Post-WWE
stories.tldr: Kairi Sane has hired Barry Bloom, a prominent agent who represents major AEW talent including Kenny Omega, The Young Bucks, and Will Ospreay, to handle her post-WWE bookings following her release in April. Now a free agent after her 90-day non-compete period ended on July 23, Sane's management change has sparked speculation she could sign with AEW, though fans previously expected her to return to Stardom in Japan.

stories.title: WWE RAW Los Angeles Matches
stories.tldr: WWE Raw General Manager Adam Pearce announced two additional matches for Monday's episode of Raw emanating from the Intuit Dome in Los Angeles, California. Je'Von Evans will face Rusev while Rey Mysterio will take on Ethan Page in a rematch from their previous encounter. The show is expected to draw over 11,000 fans and will air live on Netflix.

stories.title: Eric Bischoff WWE Memories
stories.tldr: Eric Bischoff recalled his early WWE tenure, including his quick five-minute phone call with Vince McMahon that led to his hire and his memorable RAW debut. In separate comments, Bischoff discussed WCW creative decisions, including his belief that the spontaneous decision to spray-paint the WCW World Heavyweight Championship with the NWO logo was not part of the original plan.

stories.title: CM Punk WWE SummerSlam 2026
stories.tldr: CM Punk discussed his upcoming WWE SummerSlam 2026 appearance at San Diego Comic-Con, revealing he has special ring gear planned for the two-night event. The Undisputed WWE Champion also expressed interest in working a match for AAA, WWE's sister promotion, potentially at the Allstate Arena in his hometown of Chicago as part of the Worlds Collide event later this year.

stories.title: WWE RAW
stories.tldr: WWE RAW airs tonight from the Intuit Dome in Inglewood, CA starting at 8pm ET on Netflix. The show features Roman Reigns and Seth Rollins in a face-to-face confrontation before SummerSlam, plus several other matches including Sol Ruca defending her Women's Intercontinental Title against Raquel Rodriguez.

stories.title: Rumor Roundup - Mixed Promotions
stories.tldr: WWE plans to significantly expand its use of artificial intelligence in both on-screen and promotional content despite fan backlash to previous AI-generated materials. Meanwhile, rumors suggest potential changes in WWE leadership, Lola Vice's call-up to SmackDown, Solo Sikoa receiving a major push, and creative plans brewing for AEW talent ahead of upcoming events.

stories.title: Liv Morgan Zuffa Boxing Event
stories.tldr: WWE Women's World Champion Liv Morgan attended Zuffa Boxing's July 26 event at The Theater at Madison Square Garden in New York City. The event, which aired on Paramount+, was headlined by Edgar Berlanga's TKO victory over Steven Butler. Morgan is preparing to defend her championship against IYO SKY at WWE SummerSlam.

stories.title: Bronson Reed Commentary
stories.tldr: Bronson Reed has called out an unnamed independent wrestler for allegedly using his gimmick as an excuse to inappropriately touch female fans. The WWE star, currently sidelined from competition, took to social media to demand an end to the behavior, emphasizing that hiding behind a character does not make such conduct acceptable. Reed's message has sparked discussion about performer-fan interactions and whether he should have named the wrestler involved.

stories.title: WWE NXT and Main Roster Commentary
stories.tldr: Booker T, who has been on NXT commentary since 2022, confirmed he has no plans to return to main roster commentary work. The veteran cited the demanding 52-week travel schedule as the primary reason, noting that his bones can't handle that level of constant travel. He expressed that he prefers NXT because it allows him to be himself and bring authentic energy to his work, similar to what he brings to his WWE 2K26 commentary recordings.

stories.title: WWE Unreal Season 3
stories.tldr: Bully Ray has expressed strong disapproval of WWE Unreal Season 3, arguing that the show provides only "instant gratification" and ultimately does the company more harm than good. The Hall of Famer believes WWE has exposed too much of its business through the series and social media, citing specific examples like recent discussions about John Cena calling spots loudly in the ring. Season 3 features content about Cena's Farewell Tour, AJ Lee's decade-long return, and the journeys of former NXT stars on the main roster.

stories.title: WWE Star and AAA
stories.tldr: Lola Vice has seemingly concluded her time with Lucha Libre AAA after losing the AAA World Mixed Tag Team Championship alongside Mr. Iguana to Laredo Kid and La Hiedra at Verano De Escandalo. Vice posted farewell messages on social media following the loss, suggesting her Mexico stint has ended. With an NXT Women's Championship rematch scheduled for August 4, a potential call-up to WWE SmackDown could come as soon as the August 7 episode, possibly to reunite with her real-life partner Damian Priest.

stories.title: Nick Aldis SummerSlam Debut
stories.tldr: Nick Aldis will make his long-awaited in-ring WWE debut at SummerSlam 2026 against GUNTHER after three years away from competition, temporarily stepping down as SmackDown General Manager. Former WWE star Raj Dhesi praised the decision as "very very long overdue" and believes a strong performance could convince WWE to move Aldis into a full-time wrestling role beyond the match.

stories.title: Dexter Lumis Post-WWE Return
stories.tldr: Former WWE Superstar Dexter Lumis, whose real name is Samuel Shaw, has made his official return to professional wrestling at Atomic Legacy Wrestling on July 25, reuniting with fellow ex-WWE star Joe Gacy just days after both men's 90-day non-compete clauses expired. The two were previously aligned as members of WWE's Wyatt Sicks faction before being released by the company in April 2024.

stories.title: Solo Sikoa WWE Backstage Reaction
stories.tldr: Solo Sikoa has received significant praise from WWE officials for his character development in recent weeks, particularly through his storyline involving The Bloodline, LA Knight, and Royce Keys. Company insiders are very positive about his growth and have plans to continue expanding his role prominently on weekly programming heading into SummerSlam season.

stories.title: Alexa Bliss and Charlotte Flair
stories.tldr: Alexa Bliss recently revealed that her biggest WWE highlight this year has been witnessing Charlotte Flair's personal growth and evolution beyond championship pursuits, particularly her development as a friend and teammate. During an ESPN interview, Bliss also provided an update on an arm injury she sustained from a Jade Cargill attack in July, noting she has a bone chip and overstretched ligament but is healing quickly and hopeful about returning within a couple of weeks.

stories.title: WWE Main Roster Call-ups
stories.tldr: Lola Vice is reportedly being called up to WWE's main roster and placed on SmackDown following her loss at AAA Verano de Escándalo on Saturday night. Despite the call-up news, Vice is still scheduled to challenge Kendal Grey for the NXT Women's Championship on August 4 under NXT Underground rules, where she remains undefeated.

stories.title: Royce Keys SummerSlam Debut
stories.tldr: Royce Keys, the former AEW star now known in WWE, is set to make his SummerSlam debut in a six-man tag team match alongside LA Knight and Solo Sikoa against The Usos and Jacob Fatu. Keys expressed feeling blessed about competing with these top talents, noting his long history with the Anoa'i family and Jacob Fatu specifically, dating back to 2014. Since his Royal Rumble debut in January, Keys has quickly impressed WWE management, winning the Andre The Giant Memorial Battle Royal and becoming integral to the Bloodline storyline.

stories.title: Kurt Angle WWE Segment Memories
stories.tldr: Kurt Angle recently recalled the infamous 2004 WWE segment where he shot Big Show with a tranquilizer dart gun and shaved his head, revealing that the controversial angle was Vince McMahon's idea. Though designed to generate heat, Angle admitted feeling embarrassed about the segment because of his friendship with Big Show, though he praised the veteran for being a good sport about it.

stories.title: Former WWE Star Tag Team Reunion
stories.tldr: Zoey Stark, released by WWE in April 2024 after suffering a severe knee injury, has made her in-ring return on the independent scene as Zoey Serrano. The former NXT Women's Tag Team Champion wrestled at RevPro's Women's Grand Prix on July 25, securing her first victory since departing WWE, and has reunited with former Pure Fusion Collective stablemate Shayna Baszler to team together going forward.

stories.title: WWE Leadership Stability
stories.tldr: WWE leadership changes are unlikely in the near term despite recent business concerns, including declining RAW viewership on Netflix and lower-than-expected SummerSlam ticket demand. President Nick Khan and Chief Content Officer Triple H are not expected to face real pressure until closer to 2028 if metrics don't improve. Major broadcast agreements with Netflix and USA Network extend through 2029, providing stability for current leadership.

stories.title: J-Rod WWE and TNA
stories.tldr: J-Rod, the current OVW Women's Champion, was on TNA Wrestling's radar for a creative role before being selected for WWE's upcoming SummerSlam 2026 weekend tryouts. TNA creative, led by Tommy Dreamer, decided she wasn't ready for television after she participated in a tryout match during a TNA taping. J-Rod is now among several talents invited to participate in WWE tryouts scheduled for August 1st and 2nd in Minneapolis, Minnesota.

stories.title: Dragon Lee Ladder Match Preferences
stories.tldr: WWE star Dragon Lee explained his dislike for ladder matches during an interview, revealing that he was caught off guard by how heavy and difficult real ladders are to work with. He recounted how the ladder's weight caused him to injure his arm and leg, and humorously noted that his family and neighbors warned him to be careful after he previously fell off a ladder while hanging Christmas lights.

stories.title: Austin Theory The Vision
stories.tldr: Austin Theory discussed his journey in WWE and revealed that Paul Heyman, who helped bring him into The Vision faction, gave him surprisingly simple but impactful advice when he first joined the group. Heyman told Theory to not mess things up, which Theory said he took seriously. Theory also credited Heyman with orchestrating his previous main roster opportunities, including his time with Seth Rollins' group during the pandemic era of RAW.

stories.title: WWE SmackDown July 24 Report
stories.tldr: Bryan Alvarez has published his detailed report on WWE SmackDown from July 24, 2026, covering the night's matches and storyline developments. The report is available exclusively to subscribers of the wrestling news outlet. Unfortunately, the specific details about what transpired on the show are not included in the provided excerpt.

stories.title: Chelsea Green Women's United States Championship
stories.tldr: Chelsea Green became the first-ever WWE Women's United States Champion after fan support essentially forced the company's hand to create the title and crown her as its inaugural champion. Green credits the passionate fan backing during her tournament victory over Michin for making her historic achievement, which she says will forever be part of her legacy and must be included in any championship package history.

stories.title: PFL New York Fight Card
stories.tldr: PFL New York takes place Friday from UBS Arena in Belmont Park, featuring two of the promotion's biggest stars in Usman Nurmagomedov defending his Lightweight World Title against undefeated Archie Colgan in the main event, with 15-0 Dakota Ditcheva facing Denise Kielholtz in the co-main event at women's flyweight.

stories.title: TNA Impact Title Matches
stories.tldr: TNA Impact has announced several new matches for Thursday's episode, including a Knockouts Tag Team Title rematch between Demon Bunny and The Elegance Brand, plus quarterfinal matches in the Knockouts Television Title tournament. The card already features TNA World Champion Nic Nemeth defending against Jeff Hardy and International Champion Mustafa Ali facing Jason Hotch.

stories.title: TNA Identity and Creative Direction
stories.tldr: Booker T has criticized Hulk Hogan and Eric Bischoff for dismantling TNA's unique identity during their tenure with the promotion. The former WCW World Champion specifically called out the removal of the iconic six-sided ring and expressed disappointment in Bischoff's willingness to follow Hogan's vision, which he felt was out of touch with what made TNA special.

stories.title: Dominik Mysterio AAA Alliance
stories.tldr: Dominik Mysterio turned his back on tag team partner El Grande Americano during the main event of AAA Verano de Escándalo's first night, abandoning him mid-match to allow Los Perros del Mal to secure victory. Following the betrayal, Dominik was embraced by Dorian Roldan and Omos, officially forming a powerful new alliance that Rey Mysterio witnessed in shock as the show concluded.

stories.title: Another Title Change At AEW Redemption 2026
stories.tldr: AEW Redemption 2026 in Montreal saw multiple title changes, with Andrade El Idolo defeating Mark Davis to win the AEW National Championship for the first time in his AEW career. Maya World also captured her first AEW title by defeating Hikaru Shida for the TBS Championship. The article also analyzes potential future directions for Don Callis Family members Kyle Fletcher and Kazuchika Okada, who may benefit from breaking away from the faction.

stories.title: Trios title match announced for next AEW Dynamite
stories.tldr: The Conglomeration successfully defended the AEW World Trios Championship against The Lethal Twist at Redemption, marking their sixth title defense. The Demand has now challenged the champions for a trios title match next Wednesday on AEW Dynamite in Detroit. The card will also feature an interview segment with The Young Bucks and the AEW World Tag Team Champions ahead of their All In match.

stories.title: Sheamus Names WWE Star He Wishes He Wrestled & Believes Will Be A ‘Big Hit’
stories.tldr: Sheamus has departed WWE after 20 years and officially becomes a free agent on October 1. In his first interview since the departure news, Sheamus named Ilja Dragunov as a wrestler he wishes he could have faced, believing Dragunov will be a big hit if given the right opportunity. Sheamus also highlighted Oba Femi and Trick Williams as future stars, though he did face Dragunov once in a triple threat Money in the Bank qualifier in 2024.

stories.title: Multiple Late Updates & News For Tonight’s AEW Redemption 2026 Pay-Per-View In Montreal
stories.tldr: AEW Redemption 2026 in Montreal is taking place tonight with several late-breaking updates including The Conglomeration defending the World Trios Championships against The Lethal Twist on the Buy In, and the completion of a six-way ladder match lineup featuring Nick Wayne, El Clon, Jack Perry, The Beast Mortos, Komander, and Mike Bailey with an AEW International Championship shot on the line.

stories.title: AEW Redemption 2026 ticket distribution update for tonight’s show
stories.tldr: AEW Redemption 2026 has sold under 7,000 tickets for tonight's pay-per-view at the Bell Centre in Montreal, with 6,898 tickets distributed as of Sunday, up slightly from 6,357 on Friday. The cheapest ticket available is $53.25 Canadian (approximately $37.76 USD). The Bell Centre has historically drawn larger crowds for WWE events in the same venue.

stories.title: Updated AEW Redemption betting odds released
stories.tldr: Updated betting odds for AEW Redemption in Montreal show significant movement across multiple matches. Kenny Omega's odds as AEW World Champion have shifted dramatically to -5000 against Kevin Knight, while several other title matches and featured bouts have seen notable line adjustments since Friday's initial publication.

stories.title: AEW Redemption 2026 Returns and Changes
stories.tldr: AEW Redemption 2026 takes place July 26 in Montreal as the final pay-per-view before the company's flagship Wembley Stadium event in August. The show is expected to feature multiple long-awaited returns including Buddy Matthews, Wardlow, Hologram, Ruby Soho, Dr. Britt Baker, Samoa Joe, and Hangman Adam Page, while also setting up significant changes to the promotion including new title challenges and stable dynamics heading into All In London 2026.

stories.title: Tony Khan Free Agents and WWE SummerSlam Go-Home Show
stories.tldr: AEW President Tony Khan stated he is actively monitoring the market for newly released WWE free agents, noting it's an exciting time in professional wrestling with many talented performers becoming available. Meanwhile, WWE has announced plans for the July 31 SummerSlam go-home episode of SmackDown in Green Bay, including a title vs. title match between The War Raiders and the team of Damian Priest and R-Truth, plus a qualifying ladder match spot between Giulia and Lash Legend.

stories.title: AEW Conglomeration Trios Championship Match
stories.tldr: The Conglomeration will defend the AEW World Trios Championship against The Lethal Twist at AEW Redemption Buy In. The match was set up following an incident on AEW Collision where The Lethal Twist and The Demand attacked The Conglomeration after their successful title defense. The Conglomeration, comprising Orange Cassidy, Kyle O'Reilly, and Roderick Strong, recently retained their titles against Dalton Castle and The Outrunners.

stories.title: Matt Sydal Returns to AEW
stories.tldr: Matt Sydal made his return to AEW competition on the July 25 episode of Collision after nearly two years away from the ring. Teaming with Scorpio Sky and Dante Martin as SkyFlight, Sydal faced off against The Lethal Twist in a six-man tag team match but came up short when Ricochet's interference cost his team the victory. Despite the loss, Sydal's successful return to in-ring action marked a significant moment for the veteran wrestler's comeback.

stories.title: AEW Potential Signings Report
stories.tldr: At least seven wrestlers currently in free agency are reportedly waiting to be signed by AEW, according to Wrestling Observer's Jake Jeremy. The report does not specify which talents are involved or when deals will be finalized, though it suggests more signings could be coming to the combined AEW-ROH roster. This follows AEW President Tony Khan's recent statement about actively monitoring the free agency market.

stories.title: Dustin Rhodes ALS Ice Bucket Challenge
stories.tldr: Dustin Rhodes participated in the ALS Ice Bucket Challenge after being nominated by Sting, but his video quickly turned chaotic when he was doused with ice water three times before he could finish speaking. Despite the interruptions, Rhodes managed to explain that he was taking part to raise awareness for ALS and show support for Rebel. He then nominated his daughter Dakota Runnels, Kaitlyn Borden, DDP, and his brother Cody Rhodes to continue the challenge.

stories.title: MJF Status for AEW Redemption
stories.tldr: MJF will not appear at AEW Redemption this Sunday in Montreal, as the company is instead planning to reintroduce him at All In. Tony Khan revealed that MJF has been dealing with major injuries throughout 2026 but praised his toughness for competing through the pain during his recent AEW World Championship reign. Kenny Omega will defend the title against Kevin Knight at Redemption while MJF recovers.

stories.title: AEW Talent Re-Signings
stories.tldr: AEW has been actively signing new talent throughout 2026, but the article explores seven former AEW stars who could potentially return to the company. These include Bea Priestley, Priscilla Kelly, Marko Stunt, Maki Itoh, The Good Brothers, and Jeff Cobb, many of whom have been released from WWE or are currently working abroad and could become available for AEW deals.

stories.title: Kyle Fletcher and Bandido AEW Redemption Match
stories.tldr: Kyle Fletcher and Bandido brawled at San Diego Comic-Con during a Q&A panel on Friday, escalating their rivalry ahead of their AEW International Championship match at Redemption on Sunday. The confrontation was sparked by comments from Brody King, Bandido's tag team partner, leading to a melee that required AEW President Tony Khan and security to separate the two competitors. Fletcher will defend his newly won International Championship against Bandido, who is also the current ROH World Champion and seeking to become a dual titleholder.

stories.title: Jeff Jarrett Dark Side of the Ring Views
stories.tldr: Jeff Jarrett has changed his previously critical stance on "Dark Side of the Ring" after participating in a three-part TNA-focused series. He credits the show's respectful handling of sensitive topics like the Owen Hart and Doink stories for his shift in perspective. Jarrett noted that his TNA episodes have received more positive reception than past DSOTR installments, and he agreed to participate to tell TNA's story and correct misconceptions about the company.

stories.title: Bayley's WWE Status and Appearances
stories.tldr: Bayley's WWE status remains uncertain as her contract expires in late 2026 with no new deal signed. Recent events including a loss to Lyra Valkyria at Saturday Night's Main Event, removal from WWE promotional materials, and cryptic social media activity have fueled speculation about her potential departure, with AEW reportedly interested in signing her if she becomes a free agent.

stories.title: CM Punk's WWE Career and Appearances
stories.tldr: CM Punk is thriving in his WWE Championship reign, planning special gear for his SummerSlam defense against Cody Rhodes while teasing a potential appearance at WWE x AAA Worlds Collide in Chicago to challenge Dominik Mysterio. Meanwhile, AEW's Jack Perry recently used a catchphrase identical to Punk's viral "opportunity falls out of the sky" line during a promo, raising questions about whether it was intentional or coincidental given their history.

stories.title: WWE SummerSlam AI Promotional Materials Backlash
stories.tldr: WWE released a poorly executed AI-assisted promotional poster for a SummerSlam six-woman tag team match featuring outdated photos, digitally placed championship belts, and wrestlers not in proper gear. Despite significant fan backlash and criticism from some WWE talent, the company has confirmed it plans to continue and even increase its use of AI-generated content for promotional materials and on-screen elements in the coming months.

stories.title: Trick Williams WWE Championship Aspirations
stories.tldr: Trick Williams will defend his United States Championship against returning Baron Corbin at WWE SummerSlam after Corbin attacked him post-SmackDown. The assault came after Williams fell short in a fatal four-way match, and the two have now agreed to settle their dispute in a title bout. Additionally, Williams recently expressed interest in competing in mixed tag team matches alongside his wife, Lash Legend, against couples like Seth Rollins and Becky Lynch.

stories.title: Becky Lynch WWE Career Stories
stories.tldr: Becky Lynch has opened up about her personal struggles following motherhood, revealing she experienced postpartum depression years after giving birth while weaning her daughter, a condition she managed through acupuncture. During an interview, Lynch also discussed how WWE decided to keep her as Raw Women's Champion at WrestleMania 36 despite her willingness to drop the title, citing the pandemic and desire to provide positive entertainment. Additionally, Lynch reflected on her relationship with Seth Rollins, revealing that he was the only person besides her mother who called her out when she became engaged to her previous partner while knowing it wasn't the right decision.

stories.title: J-Rod's WWE and TNA Opportunities
stories.tldr: J-Rod, the current OVW Women's Champion, recently worked a tryout match for TNA Wrestling during Nashville television tapings while simultaneously being announced for a WWE tryout at SummerSlam weekend in Minneapolis. Though TNA had previously discussed signing her during a prior regime, Tommy Dreamer determined she wasn't ready at that time. Since then, J-Rod has built an impressive resume that includes championship gold, appearances on WOW Women of Wrestling, and involvement with the American Gladiators reboot, making her a prominent figure on the independent wrestling scene.

stories.title: WWE RAW on Netflix Lineup and Updates
stories.tldr: WWE RAW will broadcast live from the Intuit Dome in Los Angeles on Monday at 8 PM ET as the go-home show for SummerSlam, featuring a weigh-in between Oba Femi and Brock Lesnar overseen by Triple H, a Women's Intercontinental Championship match between Sol Ruca and Raquel Rodriguez, and a face-to-face confrontation between Roman Reigns and Seth Rollins. The show will also include a non-title tag team match featuring The Vision, a concert performance from Joe Hendry and Danhausen, and other announced segments.

stories.title: WWE Star Horror Movie Role Update
stories.tldr: WWE star Chelsea Green has provided an update on her horror movie debut in "Red Wedding," which is currently in post-production with no confirmed release date. The film was directed by Saw franchise veteran Josh Stolberg and co-stars Rory Culkin and Lauren LaVera. Green discussed how she balanced filming with her WWE responsibilities while also opening up about how wrestling's theatrical style has hurt her screen acting career, though improvisation skills from wrestling have helped tremendously.

stories.title: WWE Leadership and Business Performance
stories.tldr: JP Morgan lowered its price target for TKO from $225 to $222 citing weaker fan sentiment, declining Raw viewership on Netflix, and softer SummerSlam ticket demand. WWE leadership is not expected to face immediate changes, but internal sources indicate that significant pressure could come around 2028 when the company's media rights deals with Netflix and USA Network expire at the end of 2029. The report notes that while WWE fan dissatisfaction exists, it is not yet considered a structural problem, though premium live event viewership continues to grow despite declining Raw ratings.

stories.title: Sami Zayn's WWE Championship Reign
stories.tldr: Sami Zayn's nine-day reign as Undisputed WWE Champion has sparked debate in the wrestling community about whether he deserved a longer title run. Former WWE star Maven joined voices like AJ Styles in expressing that while he respects how Zayn lost the title to CM Punk, the champion should have held it longer. Zayn recently lost a tag team match that would have earned him another SummerSlam title opportunity.

stories.title: WWE NXT Star Skylar Raye Car Crash
stories.tldr: WWE NXT Superstar Skylar Raye survived a serious car crash and shared photos of the aftermath on Instagram with a warning about graphic content. Despite the severity of the accident, Raye maintained her characteristic confidence and thanked supporters who reached out to her during her recovery. Fellow WWE stars including Nattie, Wendy Choo, Jaida Parker, and Reina Volcan sent well wishes in response to her post.

stories.title: Paige and Nikki Bella WWE SmackDown Return
stories.tldr: Nikki Bella returned to WWE SmackDown on July 24 after a four-month absence due to an ankle injury, saving Brie from Fatal Influence and setting up a SummerSlam match with Paige and Brie against the heel faction. When a fan misspelled "heel turn" as "heal turn," Paige quickly responded with a joke about Nikki's healed ankle, shutting down speculation about any potential turn in the newly reunited trio.

stories.title: Sheamus WWE Departure and Next Move
stories.tldr: Sheamus has departed WWE after rejecting a restructured contract that would have reduced his pay following a 17-year tenure with the company. The Irish wrestler has already begun branching out into other projects, including an appearance on Liverpool FC's pre-match coverage, and there is speculation that he could sign with AEW as a major acquisition for the promotion.

stories.title: WWE WrestleMania 43 Week and AEW New York Event
stories.tldr: WWE is expecting AEW to run a New York event during WrestleMania 43 week and has strategically booked both NXT Stand & Deliver and AAA Eternal Glory at Madison Square Garden's Infosys Theater to potentially block AEW from debuting at MSG. While Khan and AEW have not announced any plans, industry sources speculate AEW could run a stadium show in the New York area to capitalize on the wrestling fan influx during WrestleMania weekend. If both companies hold events in New York that week, it could create a major wrestling hub benefiting independent promotions, though WWE may be attempting to force those groups to choose allegiances.

stories.title: Royce Keys' Move from AEW to WWE
stories.tldr: WWE star Royce Keys recently explained his decision to leave AEW for WWE, citing it as a lifelong dream and the ultimate goal in professional wrestling. Keys emphasized that when the opportunity arose, he committed fully without hesitation, comparing himself to LeBron James in free agency. While acknowledging personal reasons he won't discuss publicly, Keys stated he had to do what was best for his career.

stories.title: WWE NXT New Referee Signing
stories.tldr: WWE has signed Katie Reynolds, also known as Alice Lane, as a new referee for the NXT brand. Reynolds brings experience from TNA and Ohio Valley Wrestling, including recognition for her quick response in stopping a match at TNA Sacrifice when a performer suffered a serious head injury. She will make her NXT debut at this weekend's house shows in Florida.

stories.title: WWE SummerSlam Tryouts
stories.tldr: WWE is holding its latest round of tryouts next week for potential recruits ahead of the 2026 SummerSlam premium live event. Notable invitees include Titus Alexander, Josh Bishop, J-Rod, Colton Theron Vaught, and Conan Lycan, among others who were notified of their invitations at least a couple of weeks prior. Some of the tryout participants have reportedly attracted interest from other wrestling companies before receiving their WWE invitations.

stories.title: Cathy Kelley USA Network Food Show Opportunity
stories.tldr: WWE personality Cathy Kelley revealed she turned down an opportunity to host a food show for USA Network because she had concerns about eating massive quantities of food on a regular basis. While interested in food-related content, Kelley felt the format requiring contestants to consume large amounts would be physically unsustainable for her. She remains open to hosting a WWE food and travel series that would highlight dining destinations in cities where wrestling events take place.

stories.title: John Cena WWE Retirement Tour Final Match
stories.tldr: John Cena revealed that tapping out with a smile during his final WWE match against GUNTHER at Saturday Night's Main Event in December was his own creative idea. Cena explained the decision was meant to subvert his "never give up" character by having him peacefully accept defeat as a way to further the business and create an unpredictable ending. The moment was discussed in detail during an appearance on Netflix's "WWE Unreal," where Triple H also explained why GUNTHER was chosen as Cena's final opponent.

stories.title: Drew McIntyre The Last Druid Character
stories.tldr: Drew McIntyre shared his first look at the character he is playing in The Last Druid, appearing shirtless in medieval-style warrior attire on a film set. The photo confirms the former WWE Champion is still actively filming the Russell Crowe action movie, putting his WWE return on hold. His agent recently clarified that McIntyre was only home for a brief weekend before returning to the movie set, and the actor appears to have broader ambitions in Hollywood beyond occasional side projects.

stories.title: Nunzio Cruiserweight Champion Paul Heyman
stories.tldr: Nunzio, who wrestled in ECW as Little Guido, credits Paul Heyman with helping him secure his WWE career. After ECW closed in 2001, Heyman became the lead writer of WWE SmackDown and used his position to advocate for his former colleague. Nunzio eventually became the WWE Cruiserweight Champion in 2005 after working his way up through dark matches and the FBI stable.

stories.title: WWE Women's Title Ladder Match Qualifier
stories.tldr: Lash Legend has earned the final qualifying spot for the five-way Interim WWE Women's Championship Ladder Match at SummerSlam 2026, facing Giulia next Friday on SmackDown. Nia Jax was denied another opportunity after losing via disqualification to Charlotte Flair, with GM Adam Pearce deciding to give her tag team partner a chance instead. The interim title tournament was created after Rhea Ripley suffered a slight meniscus tear and was ruled out of defending her championship.

stories.title: Austin Theory The Vision Faction WWE
stories.tldr: Austin Theory has credited Paul Heyman with being the driving force behind his recent recruitment into The Vision faction in late 2025. The two have maintained a relationship since their first meeting on the indie circuit, with Heyman also responsible for Theory's initial main roster call-up in 2020. Since joining The Vision, Theory has been heavily featured and is currently holding the WWE World Tag Team Championship with Bron Breakker while developing a romantic storyline with Maxxine Dupri.

stories.title: Bully Ray Vince McMahon Pro Wrestling Label
stories.tldr: Bully Ray revealed that Vince McMahon forced WWE to use the term "sports entertainment" instead of "pro wrestling" primarily to avoid paying Athletic Commission taxes. Since McMahon's departure and TKO's takeover in 2024, WWE has abandoned the sports entertainment terminology, and Ray notes that fans have embraced the return to calling it professional wrestling without complaint.

stories.title: WWE SummerSlam US Championship Match Announcement
stories.tldr: WWE Chief Content Officer Triple H has officially announced that US Champion Trick Williams will defend his title against returning star Baron Corbin at SummerSlam on August 1-2. Corbin attacked Williams following a four-way match on SmackDown, prompting Williams to challenge him for the championship at the premium live event in Minneapolis.

stories.title: LA Knight WWE Main Roster Experience
stories.tldr: LA Knight has revealed that his initial months on the WWE main roster under the Max Dupri gimmick were mentally torturous, as he felt forced to abandon the LA Knight character that earned him his promotion. After being given the opportunity to return to his original persona, Knight seized the chance and credits that decision with his subsequent success and current position as a main roster star.

stories.title: Brock Lesnar WWE Retirement Plans
stories.tldr: Brock Lesnar has teased retirement at WWE WrestleMania 42 and may conclude his in-ring career in 2026. The company is considering various high-profile opponents for his final match, ranging from emerging stars like Trick Williams and Jacob Fatu to established rivals such as Drew McIntyre and CM Punk. A potential retirement match against Oba Femi is scheduled for Hell In A Cell at SummerSlam 2026 in Lesnar's hometown of Minneapolis.

stories.title: Michael Cole WWE Announcer Commentary
