stories.tldr: WWE announcer Michael Cole discussed the critical role commentators play in professional wrestling, stating that only about 5% of wrestling stars throughout history have gotten over on their own, with most needing support from announcers to tell their stories and develop their characters for audiences.

stories.title: Triple H WWE SummerSlam Go-Home Raw
stories.tldr: Triple H will appear on WWE Raw on July 27 from Inglewood, California to host the official weigh-in between Brock Lesnar and Oba Femi ahead of their Hell in a Cell match at SummerSlam. The go-home show will also feature Sol Ruca defending her Women's Intercontinental Championship, Roman Reigns and Seth Rollins coming face-to-face, and several other segments as WWE builds toward its flagship summer event.

stories.title: AAA Verano de Escándalo Week One and Two
stories.tldr: AAA Verano de Escándalo week one saw major developments including Dominik Mysterio betraying El Grande Americano and forming a new alliance with Omos and Dorian Roldán, La Hiedra and Laredo Kid winning the AAA Mixed Tag Team Championships, and Dragon Lee being pulled from week two due to a thumb injury with Lince Dorado stepping in as his replacement for a Latin American Championship qualifier.

stories.title: Ultimate Warrior and WCW History
stories.tldr: Eric Bischoff revealed two significant WCW stories: Ultimate Warrior's debut promo ran 17 minutes instead of the planned 5 minutes, creating a live television nightmare that left everyone scrambling to end the segment, and Stone Cold Steve Austin pitched a storyline where he'd be Hulk Hogan's little brother before eventually turning on him, but the idea was rejected because Hogan only trusted working with established allies like Ric Flair.

stories.title: Gangrel WWE WCW History and AEW
stories.tldr: Gangrel recalled how Vince McMahon orchestrated a prank where he unknowingly sprayed blood on Donald Trump during a Madison Square Garden house show, later revealing it was intentional. Years later, Gangrel believes Triple H blocked him from appearing at WrestleMania 39 alongside Edge, though he eventually reunited with Copeland in AEW at Double or Nothing 2024 with House of Black.

stories.title: Perry Saturn Wrestling Game Scam Accusations
stories.tldr: Perry Saturn has accused the organizers of a blockchain-based wrestling game project of scamming multiple wrestlers by using their names and likenesses for years without paying them. After years of broken promises and unanswered questions, Saturn and other wrestlers collectively demanded their removal from the game after the project organizer refused to pay them roughly $70-75 each from a claimed $7,000 pre-sale, then contradictorily claimed that sale never happened.

stories.title: Santos Escobar Name Change to Romeo Malverde
stories.tldr: Former WWE star Santos Escobar has announced a new in-ring name, Romeo Malverde, through a dramatic video posted on social media. The rebranding comes following his release from WWE in April as part of talent cuts. Escobar is currently a free agent and has been expected to discuss potential opportunities with CMLL.

stories.title: Zoey Stark In-Ring Return
stories.tldr: Zoey Stark made her highly anticipated in-ring return after a 14-month absence, competing in RevPro's Women's Grand Prix on July 25 following a serious knee injury that required ACL, MCL, and meniscus surgery. The former WWE star competed in multiple matches throughout the day and showed no signs of rust, moving with the same intensity and physical style that defined her WWE tenure. Her return marked her first matches since being released by WWE earlier in the year.

stories.title: Gail Kim-Anthem Lawsuit Status
stories.tldr: Anthem Wrestling's ongoing lawsuit against TNA Hall of Famer Gail Kim has a new court status conference scheduled for August 28 in Nashville Chancery Court. The case stems from Anthem's January 2026 filing after Kim indicated she believed she had potential claims under the Florida Private Whistleblower Act following her 2025 departure. Anthem is seeking a court declaration affirming Kim's independent contractor status and preventing her from pursuing claims under various Florida employment statutes, while also requesting attorneys' fees.

stories.title: Chelsea Green Shares Update On Her Debut Horror Movie ‘Red Wedding’
stories.tldr: WWE's Chelsea Green has shared an update on her debut horror film "Red Wedding," directed by Saw franchise veteran Josh Stolberg. The movie is currently in post-production with no release date announced, and Green revealed she worked nights while juggling her wrestling commitments to SmackDown. She expressed excitement about the learning experience and promised fans extensive behind-the-scenes content once the film releases.

stories.title: AEW's Billy Gunn Reflects On Billy & Chuck Controversy
stories.tldr: Billy Gunn reflected on WWE's Billy & Chuck angle with Chuck Palumbo, calling it one of the most challenging runs of his career. He explained that while the initial portrayal received praise from GLAAD, the angle faced criticism after the reveal that the characters were never actually romantically linked. Gunn noted that fully committing to such a character as a straight performer would have been extremely difficult, and he emphasized he has never been homophobic, particularly highlighting his positive experience working with openly-gay AEW wrestler Anthony Bowens.

stories.title: Tony Khan Played Major Role In Creating “Timeless” Toni Storm
stories.tldr: Tony Khan played a major role in developing "Timeless" Toni Storm's character after she joined AEW in 2022, drawing inspiration from classic Golden Age Hollywood films like "All About Eve" and "Sunset Boulevard." Khan's creative vision shaped both the character and her critically acclaimed storyline with Mariah May, with RJ City serving as a key collaborator who helped translate the classic movie references into a wrestling context.

stories.title: Luke Gallows Reflects On Changes In WWE Locker Room Over The Years
stories.tldr: Luke Gallows reflected on how WWE's locker room culture has evolved significantly since he first joined at age 21 under the "old guard" mentality of leading through fear. While conditions improved considerably when he and Karl Anderson returned in 2016 and again in 2022, Gallows expressed concern about how younger wrestlers are adapting to the increasingly corporate environment, especially following TKO's takeover of the company before his 2025 release.

stories.title: WWE HOFer Kevin Nash Reveals Which NWO Theme Song He Preferred
stories.tldr: Kevin Nash revealed on his "Kliq This" podcast that he disliked the original nWo theme song and was eager to switch to the Wolfpac theme when he led that faction. Nash dismissed claims that the original nWo music was inspired by Jimi Hendrix, saying he couldn't hear any similarity. Eric Bischoff previously disclosed that licensing Hendrix's "Voodoo Child" for Hulk Hogan cost only $100,000 for worldwide rights.

stories.title: Danhausen Wants To Be Added To NBA 2K As Downloadable Character
stories.tldr: WWE Superstar Danhausen has pitched the idea of being added to NBA 2K as downloadable content, capitalizing on his ongoing comedic connection to the New York Knicks' championship season. The wrestler has frequently joked about using his "very nice, very evil" powers to remove the team's championship curse, even receiving acknowledgment from the Knicks organization as part of the gag. Speaking at San Diego Comic-Con, Danhausen humorously described the preparation and training involved in helping the team end their drought before pitching his video game appearance idea.

stories.title: AEW Free Agent Signings from Released WWE Stars
stories.tldr: Following the expiration of WWE's 90-day non-compete clauses for wrestlers released after WrestleMania 42, sources report that at least seven free agents are waiting to sign with AEW. While Tony Khan confirmed he is actively monitoring the free agent market, no specific names or signing dates have been announced, though debuts could occur at AEW Redemption or All In London next month.

stories.title: Thunder Rosa Departs Busted Open Radio Amid WWE Radio Launch
stories.tldr: Thunder Rosa has officially departed Busted Open Radio after four years as a rotating co-host, confirming speculation that arose when WWE and SiriusXM launched WWE Radio on July 27, 2026. The AEW star was not included in any of the new lineup announcements, and industry observers believe it would be impossible to keep AEW talent on a WWE-controlled show. Rosa released a heartfelt farewell statement thanking the show's hosts, producers, and fans while promising her voice will continue elsewhere.

stories.title: AEW Star Kyle Fletcher Comments and Interviews
stories.tldr: AEW's Kyle Fletcher has become one of the promotion's top young stars as the current International Champion, but he credits his constant evolution and willingness to adapt his character as key to his success. Fletcher has opened up about his four-year relationship with fellow AEW star Skye Blue, his journey overcoming early doubts sparked by Vince McMahon's dismissal of Australian accents, and how he and Skye handle the unusual social media attention surrounding their careers with humor and open communication.

stories.title: AEW Redemption 2026 Event
stories.tldr: AEW Redemption 2026 takes place this Sunday, July 26, at the Bell Centre in Montreal with strong ticket sales of 6,357 distributed. Notable absences include former World Champion Swerve Strickland, who has been out since June's Forbidden Door event but will appear at Comic Con, while MJF is expected to return very soon from injuries sustained this year. The card features major championship matches including Kenny Omega challenging for the World Title against Kevin Knight and Will Ospreay facing Jon Moxley against The Young Bucks.

stories.title: Kyle Fletcher and Bandido AEW Feud at Comic-Con
stories.tldr: Kyle Fletcher and Bandido erupted into a physical brawl at San Diego Comic-Con on Friday during an AEW panel when Fletcher confronted Brody King and Bandido intervened. Security quickly separated the two wrestlers before the fight could escalate further. The incident heightens the intensity ahead of their AEW International Championship match scheduled for Sunday at AEW Redemption in Montreal, where Fletcher will defend his title against Bandido.

stories.title: Eddie Kingston CMLL Booking Conflict with Beyond Wrestling
stories.tldr: Eddie Kingston has been pulled from Beyond Wrestling's marquee Americanrana event on August 28, 2026 in Rhode Island due to a conflicting CMLL booking in Mexico on the same night. Beyond Wrestling expressed optimism about rescheduling Kingston before the end of 2026, though he remains committed to other indie dates including a House of Glory title challenge on August 7.

stories.title: WWE and AEW Comparison Essays and Opinion Pieces
stories.tldr: Two major wrestling promotions face criticism over corporate influence and leadership decisions. WWE has struggled creatively and financially since TKO Corporation's involvement, losing star power and fan engagement through excessive price gouging, while AEW continues to operate entirely under Tony Khan's vision with little regard for fan suggestions or feedback, operating with a "my way or the highway" approach to booking and business decisions.

stories.title: AEW Mark Davis National Champion Singles Division
stories.tldr: AEW's Mark Davis has transitioned into singles competition following his tag team partner Jake Doyle's injury in January, capturing the AEW National Championship in the process. Davis discusses how his shift from tag team wrestling with Kyle Fletcher to singles competition has required significant adjustments to his conditioning and wrestling approach. Davis will defend his National Championship against Andrade El Idolo at AEW Redemption.

stories.title: Kevin Knight AEW Match Analysis
stories.tldr: Kevin Knight has identified what he believes AEW opponents Kenny Omega and Darby Allin have in common following his recent victory over Allin on Dynamite. Knight, who will challenge Omega for the AEW World Championship at Redemption, characterized both men as delusional, noting that they've both been humbled by their time in AEW since its inception while he has enjoyed smooth success climbing the ranks.

stories.title: WWE SummerSlam 2026 Card Announcements
stories.tldr: WWE SummerSlam 2026, taking place August 1-2 in Minneapolis, continues to add matches following the July 24 SmackDown. New additions include Trick Williams defending the US Championship against Baron Corbin, Finn Balor facing Sami Zayn in a WWE Championship number one contender's match, Chelsea Green and Charlotte Flair qualifying for the interim Women's Championship ladder match, and Nikki Bella returning to team with Brie Bella and Paige against Fatal Influence in a six-woman tag match.

stories.title: WWE SmackDown July 24, 2026 Episode
stories.tldr: WWE SmackDown on July 24, 2026, from Oakland Arena featured major SummerSlam match announcements including Nikki Bella's return for a six-woman tag match, Nick Aldis relinquishing his GM duties to face GUNTHER, and an intense CM Punk and Cody Rhodes promo battle ahead of their title match. The show also set up a Trick Williams vs. Baron Corbin match after Corbin's post-show attack, while Charlotte Flair qualified for the Interim Women's Championship Ladder Match after Nia Jax lost to a disqualification for the second straight week.

stories.title: WWE Hall of Fame Commentary and Legacy Stories
stories.tldr: Multiple WWE personalities have recently shared stories about their careers during podcast appearances, reflecting on early struggles, mentorship moments, and the pressures of following legendary figures. Michael Cole discussed living in Jim Ross' shadow for a decade before finding his own voice, while others like Maven criticized WWE's scripting issues and John Cena was praised for his generosity in coaching younger talent. These candid reflections offer insights into WWE's behind-the-scenes culture and the challenges performers face in developing their craft.

stories.title: Royce Keys Transition from AEW to WWE
stories.tldr: Royce Keys, formerly known as Powerhouse Hobbs, left AEW in early 2026 to join WWE, citing that becoming a WWE superstar was his lifelong dream. While Keys acknowledged there were personal reasons behind his departure that he preferred to keep private, he emphasized that WWE represented the pinnacle of professional wrestling and he did not want to live with regrets. Keys made his WWE debut in the 2026 Royal Rumble and won the Andre the Giant Memorial Battle Royal before preparing for his first SummerSlam appearance.

stories.title: Janel Grant Lawsuit Against WWE and Vince McMahon
stories.tldr: All parties in Janel Grant's sex trafficking lawsuit against WWE and Vince McMahon have jointly filed to voluntarily dismiss the case with prejudice so it can proceed to private arbitration. The agreement follows months of legal proceedings that led to McMahon's resignation from TKO in January 2024. Once the court approves the dismissal, settlement terms will be negotiated in private, potentially keeping any agreement confidential. Industry observers speculate that McMahon, now significantly wealthier after selling TKO stock, may use his resources to return to the wrestling business.

stories.title: WWE Star Personal Injury and Incident Reports
stories.tldr: Michael Cole narrowly escaped death during a rock-climbing accident on Grand Teton when he slipped on ice and tumbled 55-60 feet, stopping just inches from a 2,000-foot drop. Cole also reflected on a family medical crisis in 2001 when his wife Yolanda suffered kidney failure, requiring dialysis and eventually a successful transplant from his brother-in-law. In separate WWE news, Royce Keys was honored with his own day in his East Palo Alto hometown, and SummerSlam 2026 preparations continue with various updates on matches and talent appearances.

stories.title: Mike Santana WWE NXT Debut
stories.tldr: Mike Santana made his official WWE NXT debut on July 21, emerging after the NXT Championship street fight main event between Tony D'Angelo and Naraku. The former TNA World Champion signed with WWE after his TNA contract expired, surprising even AJ Styles, who had produced the match that preceded Santana's arrival. Santana will likely receive a new ring name, as announcers intentionally avoided mentioning his name on air.

stories.title: Dragon Lee and AJ Styles WWE Retirement Comments
stories.tldr: Dragon Lee discussed his time in WWE with AJ Styles, revealing that Styles privately informed him of his retirement immediately after they lost the World Tag Team Championship. Lee expressed frustration about limited match time for both his tag team bout and his Intercontinental Championship match with Penta, believing both deserved more time to reach their full potential. He also firmly rejected comparisons to Rey Mysterio, insisting he wants to establish his own identity as a unique performer capable of adapting to any wrestling style.

stories.title: War Raiders vs R-Truth and Damian Priest WWE SmackDown Match
stories.tldr: WWE has announced a title versus title match between War Raiders and the team of R-Truth and Damian Priest for next week's SmackDown on July 31 in Green Bay, Wisconsin. Priest and Truth hold the WWE Tag Team Championship while War Raiders are the current AAA Tag Team Champions. The match was agreed upon three weeks prior but this is the first confirmation of the specific date and location for the bout.

stories.title: Ric Flair NBA Team Switch Following LeBron James
stories.tldr: WWE Hall of Famer Ric Flair has officially switched his NBA allegiance from the Los Angeles Lakers to the Philadelphia 76ers following LeBron James' free agency signing with the team. Flair cited his close friendships with 76ers legends Charles Barkley and Allen Iverson, as well as his long-standing relationship with James, as reasons for the move. James signed a two-year, $8 million contract with Philadelphia to pursue a fifth championship alongside Joel Embiid, Tyrese Maxey, and Jaylen Brown.

stories.title: WWE Released Stars Free Agent Market
stories.tldr: Following WWE's post-WrestleMania 42 budget cuts in April, numerous wrestlers became free agents on July 23 after their 90-day non-compete clauses expired. Released talents including the Motor City Machine Guns, Kairi Sane, Zelina Vega, Aleister Black, Santos Escobar, and members of the Wyatt Sicks are now exploring opportunities across AEW, TNA, MLW, and international promotions. Industry observers predict these wrestlers could significantly impact their new companies and create fresh matchups in their respective divisions.

stories.title: Nick Aldis WWE SmackDown GM Status Change
stories.tldr: Nick Aldis officially relinquished his role as WWE SmackDown General Manager during the July 24 episode to pursue his in-ring return against Gunther at SummerSlam 2026, his first WWE match in nearly three years. Adam Pearce will oversee both Raw and SmackDown during Aldis' absence, though the move is temporary and Aldis is expected to resume his executive duties after SummerSlam concludes. The decision came during an intense contract-signing segment that ended with Gunther powerbombing Aldis through the signing table.

stories.title: WWE and NWA Crossover Appearances
stories.tldr: WWE and the NWA are expanding their working relationship following Nattie's surprise appearance for the promotion earlier this year. NWA star Kerry Morton revealed that WWE is actively looking to send more talent to the NWA, with both promotions benefiting from the collaboration. NWA owner Billy Corgan has praised WWE leadership for their willingness to cooperate on crossover appearances.

stories.title: WWE NXT Referee Addition Katie Reynolds
stories.tldr: WWE NXT has signed Katie Reynolds, a referee previously known as Alice Lane who worked for TNA Wrestling and Ohio Valley Wrestling. Reynolds will make her NXT debut at this weekend's live events in Fort Pierce and Citrus Springs, Florida. She earned recognition earlier this year for her professional handling of a TNA World Championship match involving Mike Santana and Steve Maclin when Maclin suffered a potential injury.

stories.title: Adriana Rizzo Returns to In-Ring Competition
stories.tldr: Adriana Rizzo, a 27-year-old NXT talent, has returned to in-ring competition after spending more than a year sidelined due to a torn ACL and meniscus injury suffered during WWE Performance Center training in August 2025. She faced Myka Lockwood at a July 24 live event in Fort Pierce, Florida, marking her first match since April 2025 and completing her comeback after being cleared to compete on June 25.

stories.title: Bayley WWE Future Decision
stories.tldr: Bayley's WWE contract is set to expire by the end of 2026, and she faces a major decision on her future as AEW has reportedly expressed interest in signing her. Recent storyline developments, including a loss to Lyra Valkyria and her removal from WWE's SummerSlam promotional material, have fueled speculation that WWE may be preparing to write her off television if she decides not to re-sign.

stories.title: Cody Rhodes Celebrity Potential in WWE
stories.tldr: During an appearance on The Tonight Show Starring Jimmy Fallon to promote his role as Guile in the upcoming Street Fighter movie, Cody Rhodes discussed which celebrities and athletes he believes could succeed in WWE. Rhodes expressed enthusiasm for Erling Haaland, Travis Kelce, and Jason Momoa, while diplomatically declining the idea of Tom Holland joining the company, citing his value to entertainment and children's enjoyment of his films.

stories.title: Hulk Hogan Death Anniversary and Legacy
stories.tldr: On the one-year anniversary of Hulk Hogan's death, his children Brooke and Nick released emotional statements via Instagram honoring their father's legacy. Brooke shared a poignant message about reuniting with her father in another lifetime, while Nick reflected on how his father's inspiration and values continue to shape his life and define an unrivaled legacy.

stories.title: Nikki Bella Returns to WWE
stories.tldr: Nikki Bella made her triumphant return to WWE on the July 24 episode of SmackDown after recovering from a serious ankle injury that sidelined her for nearly four months. She immediately announced a six-woman tag team match for SummerSlam, where she will team with Brie Bella and Paige against Fatal Influence and their allies. Nikki's comeback included attacking Fatal Influence after they assaulted her sister, demonstrating she is fully cleared to compete again.

stories.title: WWE Dominik Mysterio AAA Worlds Collide Appearance
stories.tldr: CM Punk teased a potential match between himself and Dominik Mysterio at AAA Worlds Collide in Chicago on September 26, during a Comic Con interaction that also involved Danhausen attempting to negotiate with the WWE Champion. Dominik is currently set to face Danhausen at SummerSlam on August 1 & 2 for a $100,000 prize, and Danhausen remains undefeated in his limited WWE in-ring appearances while building his narrative through entertaining backstage segments.

stories.title: The Colons WWE Career Reflections
stories.tldr: Primo and Epico Colon recently reflected on their favorite WWE opponents during an appearance on "Going Ringside," with Primo highlighting his memorable match against Rey Mysterio at age 19 and Epico praising his experiences facing The Big Show, Kane, and Rey Mysterio, along with tag team matches against the Dudley Boyz. Both cousins expressed deep respect for their opponents and have developed lasting friendships with many of them throughout their wrestling careers.

stories.title: Santos Escobar New Ring Name After WWE Release
stories.tldr: Former WWE star Santos Escobar has officially entered free agency following the expiration of his 90-day non-compete clause and revealed his new ring name as Romeo Malverde. Escobar, whose real name is Jorge Bolly, was released by WWE in April following WrestleMania 42 after being re-signed just months earlier in October 2025. He marked the occasion with a cinematic video showing a funeral for his Santos Escobar character and is currently appearing at San Diego Comic-Con while his next wrestling destination remains undetermined.

stories.title: Paramount and Warner Bros. Discovery Merger Legal Updates
stories.tldr: The proposed $111 billion merger between Paramount Skydance and Warner Bros. Discovery has been officially delayed after a coalition of 12 state attorneys general, led by California, filed an antitrust lawsuit challenging the deal. A federal judge extended a temporary restraining order through August 18, with arguments on a preliminary injunction scheduled for August 3. The merger will not close until after the antitrust trial concludes or June 1, 2027, whichever comes sooner, potentially costing Paramount billions in delay fees while creating uncertainty for AEW's future broadcast home.

stories.title: TNA Wrestling and AMC Crossovers
stories.tldr: TNA Wrestling is planning additional crossover collaborations with AMC following the success of Matt Hardy's Negan-inspired appearance on the July 23 episode of iMPACT. The segment, which featured Hardy using an actual replica of Lucille from The Walking Dead during the Righteous Deletion match, has reportedly encouraged both companies to expand their partnership beyond this initial tribute. Separately, former WWE wrestler Victoria Crawford (Alicia Fox) has been released from TNA, marking another recent departure from the promotion.

stories.title: Nikki Storm Returns at OTT Wrestling
stories.tldr: Former WWE Superstar Nikki Storm (Nikki Cross) made her in-ring return at OTT Wrestling on July 24, 2026, competing in a mixed tag team match alongside her husband Big Damo. The unannounced appearance marked her first match since departing WWE and her debut under her pre-WWE ring name Nikki Storm, with Storm expressing gratitude for the opportunity to wrestle with her husband after nearly a decade of conflicting schedules.

stories.title: Rebel ALS Health and Community Support
stories.tldr: Rebel, a professional wrestler battling ALS, has found meaning in her diagnosis by witnessing the outpouring of love and support from the wrestling community. AEW colleagues and wrestlers from across the industry are raising awareness and funds through initiatives like the Ice Bucket Challenge and benefit events, with proceeds going to ALS research organizations. Rebel remains committed to advocating for a cure despite knowing one won't come in time to save her own life.

stories.title: Wrestling Title Changes and Historical Records
stories.tldr: July 24th has been a historically significant date for professional wrestling title changes, with 271 major championship transitions recorded on this date. Notable champions crowned on this day include Lou Thesz (NWA World Heavyweight Title in 1957), Sensational Sherri (WWF Women's Title in 1987), Kenta Kobashi (AJPW Unified Triple Crown Heavyweight Title in 1996), and Kurt Angle (WCW World Heavyweight Title in 2001). The most recent July 24th title change occurred in 2022 when Kyle Fletcher and Mark Davis won the NJPW Strong Openweight Tag Team Titles.

stories.title: Maven Calls Scott Hall’s Reaction To Infamous WCW Promo A “Master Class”
stories.tldr: Maven recently praised Scott Hall's professionalism during an infamous WCW promo that also featured Kevin Nash and Ric Flair, highlighting how Hall stayed perfectly in character while clearly aware of the absurdity unfolding around him. Maven credited Hall with understanding he was leading the joke and managing to avoid breaking character despite visibly struggling not to laugh during the rambling segment.

stories.title: WWE’s Seth Rollins Considered Polygamy Before Dating Becky Lynch
stories.tldr: Seth Rollins once joked about considering polygamy during his friendship with Becky Lynch before they started dating. Rollins later explained he was going through a difficult time with failed relationships while constantly traveling for WWE, making him question whether monogamy was the problem. He realized he simply hadn't met the right person yet, and once he and Lynch began dating in February 2019, all his doubts disappeared, leading to their engagement, marriage in 2021, and a daughter together.

stories.title: Triple H Will Host Brock Lesnar And Oba Femi Weigh-In On 7/27 WWE Raw
stories.tldr: Triple H will host the official weigh-in between Brock Lesnar and Oba Femi on WWE Raw on July 27, ahead of their scheduled Hell in a Cell match at SummerSlam. The announcement was made during WWE SmackDown on July 24, and the weigh-in is part of a stacked Raw episode that also features Roman Reigns and Seth Rollins going face-to-face and a Women's Intercontinental Championship match.

stories.title: WOR: Dave Meltzer goes to Arena Mexico
stories.tldr: Dave Meltzer recently traveled to Arena Mexico where he met with Salvador Lutteroth III and explored what makes CMLL special. The Wrestling Observer Radio episode covered this trip along with other major wrestling news including updates on the Paramount/WBD situation, AEW Redemption, AEW Dynamite ratings, SummerSlam ticket sales, and WWE Radio developments.

stories.title: SmackDown Star Says Locker Room is Sick of Cody Rhodes and CM Punk Being the Faces of WWE
stories.tldr: Damian Priest confronted Cody Rhodes backstage on SmackDown, expressing frustration that the locker room is tired of seeing the same stars dominating the main event picture. Priest warned that whoever leaves SummerSlam as WWE Champion will be challenged, suggesting a shift in WWE's top talent hierarchy could be coming soon. The comments reflect broader tension about opportunities going to established names and part-timers rather than full-time roster members grinding week to week.

stories.title: Kevin Nash Regrets Not Getting Final Chance To Tell Hulk Hogan He Loved Him
stories.tldr: Kevin Nash expressed deep regret over not getting a final chance to tell Hulk Hogan he loved him before Hogan's death. Nash was on a cruise ship in Alaska when he learned of Hogan's passing and said conflicting health reports led him to believe Hogan would recover. He connected this regret to previous losses, including Scott Hall and his own son, saying he never got final conscious conversations with either of them.

stories.title: New WWE Hire To Debut This Weekend
stories.tldr: TNA Wrestling referee Alice Lane has joined WWE under the new ring name Katie Reynolds and will make her debut this weekend at NXT live events in Florida. Additionally, WWE referee Jessika Carr has been involved in an ongoing storyline with Becky Lynch that has sparked speculation about a potential in-ring match between them at a future premium live event.

stories.title: Who is Mr. SummerSlam? Big Vinny V’s honorable mention: Shawn Michaels
stories.tldr: Shawn Michaels earned an honorable mention in a countdown of SummerSlam's greatest performers despite being primarily known for WrestleMania excellence. Across 11 SummerSlam appearances, Michaels had four matches rated as the show's best, most notably his legendary 1995 ladder match with Razor Ramon that received universal acclaim and sparked Dave Meltzer to compare him favorably to Ric Flair as the top American wrestler of his era.

stories.title: Road To Back In The Saddle: Mortimer Blankenship III On Making Wrestlers The Stars
stories.tldr: Mortimer Blankenship III, known as "The Muttonchop Millionaire," discusses his accidental entry into professional wrestling through theater experience and his philosophy that managers should make wrestlers shine brighter. With over 15 years in the business, he balances his on-screen role as a hated heel manager with his off-screen commitment to mentoring the next generation of wrestlers.

stories.title: Former WWE Star Recalls Scrapped Faction Return Plans That Would Have Led To Undertaker WrestleMania Match
stories.tldr: Kevin Thorn reveals that he was supposed to be part of a faction led by Hade Vansen set to feud with The Undertaker at WrestleMania 25, but the plan was scrapped after Vansen's in-ring performance disappointed WWE officials. Instead of facing the faction, The Undertaker ended up in the classic match against Shawn Michaels. Thorn had to rush back from hip surgery in just six weeks to prepare for the angle that ultimately never happened.

stories.title: WOL: Redemption, Khan media call, Swerve, Adam Abdalla talks PRODUCE
stories.tldr: Wrestling Observer Live covered multiple major wrestling stories including WWE releases and career moves, Tony Khan's media call regarding AEW operations, updates on Swerve Strickland, and an interview with Adam Abdalla about Produce Wrestling's event scheduled before the AEW PPV this Sunday.

stories.title: Dave Meltzer Breaks Down WWE PLE Viewership On Netflix Through First Half Of 2026
stories.tldr: Dave Meltzer analyzed WWE's 2026 Premium Live Event viewership on Netflix, revealing that while major shows like Royal Rumble and WrestleMania showed growth, smaller PLEs and weekly programming like NXT struggled despite nearly 17% more homes having access to the content, suggesting overall interest in WWE programming may be declining.

stories.title: Wrestling Weekly: Free agent frenzy & AEW Redemption picks
stories.tldr: With several WWE wrestlers now free agents, wrestling analysts Les Thatcher and Vic Sosa discuss where these performers might land, including potential destinations like AEW, ROH, TNA, and other promotions. The duo also provides their predictions for the upcoming AEW Redemption event scheduled for this weekend.

stories.title: Report: WWE Taking Cautious Approach To Rhea Ripley’s Return
stories.tldr: WWE is taking a cautious approach to Rhea Ripley's return after she tore her meniscus at Clash in Italy while defending her WWE Women's Championship against Jade Cargill. She will miss SummerSlam, prompting WWE to create an Interim Women's Championship Ladder Match. The company is prioritizing her full recovery with hopes she'll be ready by fall rather than risk further injury by rushing her back.

stories.title: AEW Redemption PPV 2026
stories.tldr: MJF is absent from AEW Redemption due to major injuries accumulated during an active 2026 championship reign, though Tony Khan emphasized the injuries are not long-term concerns and the former world champion should return soon. Khan also addressed other talent status issues including granting Tay Melo's release request, confirming Anna Jay's contract extension, and hinting at Swerve Strickland and Hangman Page's imminent returns. Kenny Omega will defend his newly-won AEW World Championship against Kevin Knight instead of facing MJF at the event.

stories.title: Tay Melo AEW release
stories.tldr: Tony Khan confirmed during the AEW Redemption media call that Tay Melo requested her release from AEW, but clarified that reports claiming the request dated back to 2025 were inaccurate. Melo approached Khan just weeks ago after a June 6 Collision match, expressing her desire to step away from wrestling entirely. Khan stated he will grant her release and has not booked her since their conversation.

stories.title: Sammy Guevara AEW status
stories.tldr: Sammy Guevara's AEW status sparked online speculation after he tweeted "new bio" on July 19, 2026, with fans assuming he had removed AEW from his Twitter profile. However, Tony Khan and Bryan Alvarez confirmed that nothing has changed—Guevara was never listed in his bio to begin with, and he remains an active member of AEW and Ring of Honor as one-half of the ROH World Tag Team Champions.

stories.title: Anna Jay contract extension with AEW
stories.tldr: Anna Jay has signed a contract extension with AEW and will remain with the company for an extended period, according to AEW President Tony Khan. The 28-year-old wrestler is currently sidelined with an undisclosed injury and recently underwent an MRI, with no timetable announced for her return. Khan also revealed that her tag team partner Tay Melo has requested her release from AEW, which will be granted.

stories.title: AEW Dynamite and Revolution programming
stories.tldr: The wrestling media covered AEW's go-home show for Revolution, with Bryan and Vinny discussing efforts to generate interest in what they characterized as a lesser programming effort. The coverage included recaps of both AEW Dynamite and NXT, with notable tension during the NXT discussion requiring Bryan to manage Vinny's reaction to the show.

stories.title: AEW Collision programming
stories.tldr: AEW has announced a substantial card for Saturday's Collision broadcast, featuring an AEW Trios Championship defense by The Conglomeration against Dalton Castle and The Outrunners, plus matches involving the Young Bucks, Tommaso Ciampa, and several other top competitors. The show will serve as the go-home event for Sunday's Redemption pay-per-view, with multiple matches building toward that card.

stories.title: AEW international tag team tournament
stories.tldr: Tony Khan has been seriously considering a major international tag team tournament for AEW that would feature teams from the company's partner promotions around the world, similar to the classic Crockett Cup. Khan revealed these plans during the AEW Redemption media call, indicating the tournament could include both established and new tag teams, with potential expansion to the women's division once it develops further.

stories.title: AEW free agent monitoring
stories.tldr: AEW President Tony Khan has confirmed the company is actively monitoring the free agent market following recent WWE releases, though he has not announced specific signings. Several prominent wrestlers including the Motor City Machine Guns, Kairi Sane, and others have been linked to potential AEW deals, with fans speculating about arrivals ahead of the Redemption 2026 event.

stories.title: AEW visa issues for wrestlers
stories.tldr: The Beast Mortos and El Clon have received approval for their visas and can now compete in AEW events in the United States. El Clon has already returned to action at a recent Collision taping in Nashville, while Mortos is expected to be available for upcoming shows. Both wrestlers had been sidelined from competing in the U.S. due to visa complications.

stories.title: AEW star former WWE talent backstage
stories.tldr: Doc Gallows, a former WWE and NJPW wrestler, was spotted backstage at AEW's recent Dynamite and Collision tapings in Nashville, Tennessee. While he did not make any on-camera appearances, Gallows was there to visit friends and former colleagues from his time in New Japan Pro Wrestling, including The Young Bucks and Kazuchika Okada. Since his third WWE release in February 2025, Gallows has remained active on the independent wrestling circuit with his long-time tag team partner Karl Anderson.

stories.title: Ashley D'Amboise wrestling return
stories.tldr: Ashley D'Amboise, a former AEW and ROH talent, is making her long-awaited in-ring return after nearly two years away from professional wrestling. She will face Sara Wilder at Coastal Championship Wrestling's Game of War event on July 25 in Port St. Lucie, Florida. Her absence was primarily due to a serious ankle injury suffered in June 2023 that required extended rehabilitation, followed by mental health challenges from watching others compete during her recovery.

stories.title: AEW ROH Hall of Fame revival
stories.tldr: Tony Khan expressed interest in reviving the Ring of Honor Hall of Fame during an appearance on the Battleground Podcast. Khan stated he has not yet added inductees to the ROH Hall of Fame since acquiring the company, but believes there are worthy candidates for induction. He also indicated openness to creating a separate AEW Hall of Fame in the future.

stories.title: Mick Foley joining AEW
stories.tldr: AEW President Tony Khan announced that wrestling legend Mick Foley will become a more regular presence on AEW programming, though not necessarily appearing every week. Khan praised Foley's contributions to the company, highlighting his experience, positive attitude, and fresh perspective that benefits the wrestlers and creative direction of the promotion.

stories.title: AEW All In afterparty with Mercedes Moné
stories.tldr: Mercedes Moné will perform her first-ever DJ set at the Sweet Chin Disco: All In Afterparty on August 30, 2026, near Wembley Stadium following AEW All In. The event will also feature a live rap performance from Lio Rush and is expected to draw over 1,000 wrestling fans. VIP meet-and-greet tickets with Moné are available for £75, while general admission starts at £20.

stories.title: AEW Lio Rush match in England
stories.tldr: AEW and ROH talent Lio Rush has been confirmed for a first-time ever match against UK indie standout Rhio at PROGRESS Wrestling's "Wrestling Over Everything" event on August 31st at the Electric Ballroom in Camden, London. Rush, who has prior history with PROGRESS, will face Rhio, a multi-time champion across British independent wrestling promotions.

stories.title: Tony Khan AEW commentary on WWE counterprogramming
stories.tldr: AEW President Tony Khan addressed WWE's practice of scheduling events on the same dates and in the same markets as major AEW shows, calling it the "predatory nature of scheduling" while also acknowledging it as a compliment to AEW's success. WWE has scheduled AAA and NXT events to coincide with AEW's All In in London on August 30 and All Out in Chicago on September 26, with venues located approximately 20-30 minutes apart in the Chicago market.

stories.title: Jake Hager Power Slap and wrestling return
stories.tldr: Jake Hager, formerly known as Jack Swagger in WWE, has announced plans to return to professional wrestling after stating he was retired last year. During a recent podcast interview, Hager revealed he has been in talks with Juggalo Championship Wrestling (JCW) to lock down dates with the promotion. He continues to balance wrestling with his trucking company and rental property investments while also competing in Dana White's Power Slap promotion.

stories.title: WWE creative commentary and criticism
stories.tldr: Multiple wrestling analysts and personalities have criticized WWE's creative direction, pointing to issues including insufficient time for character development, overuse of hometown "cheap pops," missed storytelling opportunities, and improper character protection. The consensus suggests WWE's massive content output has overwhelmed its creative process, leading to continuity problems and booking decisions that undermine long-term storytelling.

stories.title: WWE released stars free agency
stories.tldr: A major wave of WWE roster cuts from April 2026 has resulted in numerous wrestlers becoming free agents as their 90-day non-compete clauses expired on July 23-24, 2026. Notable releases including Kairi Sane, Zelina Vega (now Xelina), Zoey Stark (now Zoey Serrano), Aleister Black, Motor City Machine Guns, and many others have begun teasing their next career moves through social media. Several performers are already lined up for appearances at independent promotions, with some expected to sign with major companies like AEW.

stories.title: AJ Styles retirement and legacy
stories.tldr: AJ Styles retired from in-ring competition at WWE Royal Rumble 2026 after losing to Gunther, concluding a 10-year WWE tenure. Since stepping away, Styles has found fulfillment mentoring young talent at the Performance Center and producing matches for Evolve, while occasionally appearing on podcasts to discuss his legacy, his son Avery's wrestling journey, and current wrestling topics. Styles acknowledges his legacy transcends WWE alone due to his time in TNA and New Japan, and while he doesn't miss the physical toll of wrestling, he cherishes the adrenaline rush that in-ring competition provided.

stories.title: Bayley contract negotiations and free agency
stories.tldr: Bayley faces a major free agency decision as her WWE contract expires later in 2026, with both WWE and AEW reportedly interested in securing her services. WWE has strategically written her off television in a way that allows for her return if she re-signs, similar to Ricochet's departure in 2024. The wrestling veteran could leverage significant negotiating power for improved contract terms, though some observers suggest she consider opportunities beyond professional wrestling altogether.

stories.title: WWE SummerSlam card and matches
stories.tldr: WWE's SummerSlam card is still being finalized for the two-night event on August 1-2 in Minneapolis, with 12-13 matches expected and 2-3 additional bouts still to be announced. Notable developments include the World Tag Team Championship match remaining unconfirmed, Penta vs. Chad Gable for the Intercontinental Championship being positioned for the opening ESPN hour, and significant card changes stemming from Rhea Ripley's torn meniscus injury. The event is expected to feature major title defenses and potentially shift several storylines heading forward.

stories.title: Dragon Lee WWE career and interactions
stories.tldr: Dragon Lee has opened up about several significant moments in his WWE career during a recent interview with Chris Van Vliet, including his viral motorcycle photo with The Undertaker, his tag team championship reign with AJ Styles, and his desire for a rematch with Gunther after being unmasked on Raw. The masked wrestler also revealed his dream match with Rey Mysterio and discussed his memorable WrestleMania 42 ladder match experience.

stories.title: Rhea Ripley injury impact on SummerSlam
stories.tldr: Rhea Ripley's torn meniscus injury forced WWE to make significant creative changes to the SummerSlam card. Rather than rush her return, WWE decided to crown an Interim Women's Champion via ladder match while keeping Ripley as the reigning champion. The injury ripple effect displaced multiple competitors including Tiffany Stratton from her hometown title defense and scrapped a planned Jade Cargill vs Charlotte Flair match, with WWE optimistic for Ripley's return in the fall.

stories.title: WWE Radio partnership with SiriusXM
stories.tldr: WWE and SiriusXM announced the launch of WWE Radio, a new 24/7 dedicated channel launching Monday, July 27 on channel 156, replacing the previous Pro Wrestling Nation station. The channel will feature live play-by-play coverage of all WWE Premium Live Events, popular wrestling shows like Busted Open, and exclusive WWE podcasts. While the partnership makes strong business sense for both parties, critics note it formalizes what was already an industry reality: the blurring of lines between WWE-affiliated media personalities and independent wrestling commentary.

stories.title: Batista retirement from wrestling
stories.tldr: Dave Bautista has definitively stated he will never return to professional wrestling, preferring to pursue manual labor or live in poverty rather than tarnish his storybook ending against Triple H at WrestleMania 35. The former World Champion revealed he entered wrestling out of financial desperation with two children and no money, and struggled financially even after winning the World Heavyweight Championship in 2005, taking out weekly $300 loans from check-cashing stores. He contrasted the grueling physical, mental, and financial demands of wrestling's nightly travel with the relative luxury of his Hollywood acting career.

stories.title: Tom Brady WWE angle speculation
stories.tldr: Tom Brady and Logan Paul have been building a public feud that has caught the attention of WWE, with reports indicating ongoing conversations between Brady and the company. While nothing is officially confirmed, the repeated confrontations between the two—including a slap at Fanatics Fest and tension at the FIFA World Cup Final—have sparked interest from wrestlers and commentators about a potential WWE angle. Responses from figures like Dutch Mantell, Alexa Bliss, and Trick Williams suggest mixed enthusiasm, with some welcoming the idea while others like Williams have challenged Brady's credibility in professional wrestling.

stories.title: WWE and AEW competition during WrestleMania 43 weekend
stories.tldr: WWE is expecting AEW to run a major show in the United States during WrestleMania 43 weekend in April 2027, when WWE holds the event in Saudi Arabia. WWE announced its stateside plans, including NXT Stand & Deliver, AAA Eternal Glory, and watch parties at Madison Square Garden, nearly nine months in advance specifically to counter AEW's anticipated competitive presence. This represents a significant strategic moment as WWE takes WrestleMania outside North America for the first time since 2002, while AEW has a historic opportunity to host the biggest U.S. wrestling show that weekend.

stories.title: WWE Saturday Night's Main Event New York Knicks integration
stories.tldr: WWE's day-to-day decision-makers were reportedly not enthusiastic about the heavy integration of the New York Knicks throughout Saturday Night's Main Event at Madison Square Garden, feeling the crossover went further than preferred. While NBA stars Karl-Anthony Towns and Jalen Brunson were prominently featured in matches and angles, internal sources indicated the company understood the significance but believed the level of basketball content exceeded what many in WWE wanted. The Knicks integration was a one-time effort for ESPN coverage, with the team not expected to appear at future WWE events like SummerSlam.

stories.title: WWE SummerSlam tryouts
stories.tldr: WWE is hosting tryouts during SummerSlam week in Minneapolis, with a new wave of independent and international wrestlers confirmed to participate. The company is also planning an expanded 2027 Fanatics Fest featuring major WWE legends, as the promotion looks to capitalize on the success of this year's event where talents like Cody Rhodes and Charlotte Flair drew significant fan interest.

stories.title: Penta unmasking incident at Fanatics Fest
stories.tldr: Penta was briefly shown without his mask during N3on's live stream at Fanatics Fest NYC, sparking criticism of WWE's decision to allow streamers backstage access. Dutch Mantell and James Romero argued that WWE bears responsibility for the incident, as the company neither warned wrestlers about cameras nor prevented live streaming in the area. WWE allegedly granted backstage access to appeal to younger audiences through popular online personalities. N3on apologized and deleted the footage, but the unmasked images had already spread across social media.

stories.title: Fanatics Fest 2027 WWE legends
stories.tldr: Fanatics Fest 2027 is planning a major expansion of WWE legends appearances following this year's successful event. Stone Cold Steve Austin and Bret Hart are being discussed as potential attendees, with WWE viewing the convention as highly profitable after strong fan response to Cody Rhodes, Danhausen, and Charlotte Flair. The expansion comes as the traditional WWE World convention is not expected to return to the United States in 2027.

stories.title: WWE NXT viewership increase
stories.tldr: WWE NXT experienced a significant week-to-week viewership increase on July 21, 2026, drawing 690,000 viewers with a 0.09 demo rating on The CW Network, up from 531,000 viewers and 0.05 demo the previous week. While viewership grew 159,000 viewers week-to-week, year-over-year comparisons show a modest 0.6% viewership increase but a notable 35.7% decline in the key P18-49 demographic when compared to July 2025.

stories.title: WWE Money in the Bank 2026
stories.tldr: WWE has scheduled Money in the Bank 2026 in New Orleans with an impressive Women's Money in the Bank Ladder Match. The article highlights eight potential female competitors including Sol Ruca, Lyra Valkyria, Raquel Rodriguez, Roxanne Perez, Giulia, and Blake Monroe, each positioned as strong candidates based on their recent storylines and character development. The Women's roster is at an all-time high in talent depth, promising an exciting match for the prestigious briefcase.

stories.title: Alexa Bliss injury at WWE SmackDown
stories.tldr: Alexa Bliss suffered a potential bone chip and overstretched ligament to her left arm during a July 10th SmackDown match against Jade Cargill, when Cargill used a steel chair to bend her arm backward. Bliss appeared on ESPN's Vibe Check to discuss the injury, revealing that while it's healing quickly, she's sidelined for a couple of weeks and managing the inconvenience of wearing a protective brace.

stories.title: CM Punk WWE storyline with Cody Rhodes
stories.tldr: Dutch Mantell criticized how Cody Rhodes reacted during his recent backstage confrontation with CM Punk, saying it made Rhodes look like a "douche" despite praising the creative angle of Punk accidentally hitting him with the championship belt. Mantell also questioned the logic of the two wrestlers repeatedly telling the backstage camera to leave, though he acknowledged the segment successfully built tension for their SummerSlam match. He expects both wrestlers to deliver a quality match when they face off.

stories.title: GUNTHER WWE championship and character
stories.tldr: AJ Styles recently shared that GUNTHER is a watch collector and recalled an unexpected encounter with the WWE star in Las Vegas. Styles described GUNTHER as a genuinely nice person away from the ring, despite his intimidating on-screen character. The encounter occurred while GUNTHER was waiting for his family to arrive in the United States and was browsing watches at a shop.

stories.title: Mike Santana WWE NXT debut from AEW
stories.tldr: Mike Santana made his official WWE NXT debut on July 21 after signing from AEW, joining a growing list of former AEW talent in WWE. The article speculates on eight current AEW stars who could potentially follow suit, including Sammy Guevara, Tay Melo, Kamille, Wardlow, Scorpio Sky, and others who may be underutilized or seeking fresh opportunities.

stories.title: Kevin Nash WWE Hall of Fame commentary
stories.tldr: Kevin Nash recently explained the key differences between the harness systems used by Sting in WCW and Owen Hart in WWF, noting that WCW's apparatus had a quick release mechanism that required the performer's feet to be on the ground, preventing the type of accident that led to Hart's tragic death at Over the Edge in 1999.

stories.title: Tiffany Stratton SummerSlam and Rhea Ripley feud
stories.tldr: Tiffany Stratton is competing in a five-woman ladder match at SummerSlam for the interim WWE Women's Championship and hopes to win the title en route to eventually facing Rhea Ripley in a high-stakes feud. While Stratton and Ripley have crossed paths before, they have never been involved in a significant singles rivalry. Ripley is currently sidelined with a knee injury of indefinite length.

stories.title: Abyss WWE Mattel action figure
stories.tldr: TNA Hall of Famer Chris Park, known as Abyss, is receiving a WWE Mattel action figure despite never wrestling under that gimmick in WWE. The announcement was made at San Diego Comic-Con 2026 by Ringside Collectibles as part of WWE's collaboration with TNA. Park has been working as a WWE producer since 2019 and was inducted into the TNA Hall of Fame in 2018.

stories.title: Pat McAfee music career
stories.tldr: Pat McAfee announced his debut album titled "The Diary of a Polarizing Figure" will be released on August 14th, 2026. The former WWE personality and current ESPN host has been working on music for 20 years and plans to share his story through the album. McAfee's announcement comes after his pro wrestling career ended following WrestleMania 42, where his involvement in the Cody Rhodes-Randy Orton feud drew significant fan and wrestler criticism.

stories.title: TNA Impact programming and matches
stories.tldr: TNA Impact aired on July 23, 2026 with major championship action including Nic Nemeth retaining the TNA World Title against KC Navarro and The Hardys defeating The Righteous in a cinematic Righteous Deletion match with Jeff Hardy reviving his Antichrist persona. Looking ahead to July 30, Jason Hotch will challenge Mustafa Ali for the TNA International Championship after winning a roster vote, and the Knockouts Television Title tournament continues with Indi Hartwell facing Thea Hail.

stories.title: TNA Knockouts TV Title Tournament
stories.tldr: The TNA Knockouts Television Championship tournament continued on July 23rd with Wendy Choo and Elayna Black ending their first-round match in a 10-minute time-limit draw, eliminating both competitors and giving M by Elegance an automatic bye to the semifinals. Jada Stone defeated Alisha Edwards to advance to the second round, where she will face Jody Threat, while other quarterfinal matchups were confirmed featuring Indi Hartwell vs. Thea Hail and Mara Sade vs. Heather By Elegance.

stories.title: AAA action figure deal with Mattel
stories.tldr: Mattel and WWE have announced a new multi-year global licensing agreement to produce Lucha Libre AAA action figures beginning Fall 2027. The deal was announced at San Diego Comic-Con on July 23, 2026, and expands Mattel's WWE portfolio to include the iconic Mexican lucha libre promotion. The initial line will feature Psycho Clown, El Hijo del Vikingo, La Parka, and Mr. Iguana with his sidekick La Yezca, with a made-to-order Mr. Iguana figure debuting at Comic-Con.

stories.title: STARDOM wrestler retirement
stories.tldr: Multi-time STARDOM Champion Natsupoi announced her retirement during a press conference on July 23, 2026, setting her final match for January 3, 2027 at the Yokohama Budokan. The 31-year-old wrestler cited her recent marriage to Shingo Takagi and desire to pursue a different life chapter as reasons for stepping away after over 12 years in the wrestling business. STARDOM President Taro Okada expressed full support for her retirement while leaving the door open for a potential return if her feelings change.

stories.title: Hardy family TNA Righteous Deletion matches
stories.tldr: Matt Hardy paid homage to The Walking Dead's Negan during a Righteous Deletion match on TNA iMPACT on July 23, complete with a barbed-wire bat resembling Lucille and recreating Negan's famous "Eenie, Meenie, Miney, Moe" victim selection scene. The Hardys successfully defended their TNA World Tag Team Championship against The Righteous in the cinematic match filmed at the Hardy Compound. The tribute was particularly fitting given TNA Wrestling now airs on AMC, the network behind The Walking Dead's global success.

stories.title: TNA creative and storylines
stories.tldr: TNA Wrestling has several established stars who could revitalize their careers by bringing back old character personas from their past. The article highlights six potential candidates including Nic Nemeth, The Hardys, Mustafa Ali, Frankie Kazarian, Rosemary, and Elijah, each with unique character iterations from their time in TNA or other major promotions that could become focal points of the company's programming.

stories.title: Vince Russo TNA commentary
stories.tldr: Vince Russo responded to accusations of "revisionist history" regarding his departure from TNA Wrestling by explaining he walked away from a six-figure job due to an unbearable work environment filled with office politics and toxic workplace dynamics. He credited his current positive experience working with Joe Bruce at JCW as evidence that his issues were specific to TNA's management culture, while defending the authenticity of his account detailed in his new book "Total Non-Stop Agony: The Rise and Fall of TNA."

stories.title: TNA search interest analysis
stories.tldr: Google search interest for TNA IMPACT has declined 30 percent over the last 90 days compared to the previous quarter, though the Thursday night show still maintains 8 percent higher interest than the same period last year. Search spikes correlate directly with championship matches and major debuts, with the May 14 episode generating the strongest interest at a score of 100. While backstage releases in late June generated curiosity about TNA as a company, that interest failed to translate into viewership interest for the weekly television program.

stories.title: AAA Verano de Escandalo 2026
stories.tldr: AAA's Verano de Escandalo 2026 kicks off on July 25 with two matches: a Mixed Tag Team Championship defense by Mr. Iguana and Lola Vice against Laredo Kid and La Hiedra, and a triple threat featuring Dragon Lee, Mecha Wolf, and La Parka competing for a spot in the vacant AAA Latin American Championship match at TripleMania 34.

stories.title: Eddie Kingston CMLL commitment
stories.tldr: Eddie Kingston has been pulled from Beyond Wrestling's Americanrana event on August 28, 2026, due to a scheduling conflict with a CMLL commitment in Mexico. Kingston, who is signed to AEW and competes regularly in Ring of Holland, is set for what appears to be his CMLL debut. Beyond Wrestling expressed hope that Kingston could return before the end of the year if his schedule permits, though no official CMLL event has been announced for him yet.

stories.title: PRODUCE Wrestling Alison Pill crossover
stories.tldr: Actress Alison Pill, known for roles in The Newsroom and Scott Pilgrim vs. The World, appeared in a promotional video for PRODUCE Wrestling alongside AEW star "Speedball" Mike Bailey. The video humorously explores Canadian and Quebecbois cultural differences while promoting the PRODUCE PRODUIT event scheduled for Sunday, July 26.

stories.title: Title changes on July 23
stories.tldr: July 23 has historically seen approximately 264 major and notable professional wrestling title changes throughout history. The date features several significant title victories including Shawn Michaels winning the WWF Intercontinental Title in 1995, King Booker capturing the WWE World Heavyweight Title in 2006, and Claudio Castagnoli winning the ROH World Title in 2022. While less active than some other days during the week, July 23 remains a notable date in wrestling history for title changes across multiple promotions.

stories.title: AEW Star Seemingly Takes Shot at Sheamus With Brogue Kick Amid Signing Speculation
stories.tldr: Brian Cage posted a social media video of his big boot from AEW Collision with a caption referencing Sheamus' Brogue Kick, seemingly taking a lighthearted jab at the WWE star amid growing rumors of his potential signing to AEW. Sheamus has appeared to leave WWE and cannot sign with another promotion until October 1, 2026, due to the standard 90-day non-compete clause, though there are mixed opinions within AEW about bringing him in.

stories.title: Released WWE Star Bids Farewell to Old Gimmick and Embraces New Identity in Cryptic Video
stories.tldr: Former WWE star Joseph Sawyer, formerly known as Joe Gacy, has officially ended his non-compete clause and introduced his new ring identity through an emotional cinematic video titled "Acceptance." The video symbolically buries the Huskus the Pig Boy mask from his Wyatt Sicks days as he transitions to his independent wrestling career, with his first match scheduled for July 24 at Wrestling REVOLVER's The Silence of the Lambs event.

stories.title: Tony Khan Provides AEW Status Updates on Swerve Strickland and Adam Page
stories.tldr: AEW President Tony Khan provided status updates on two absent stars during the AEW Redemption media call. Swerve Strickland has been working on outside projects since losing to Will Ospreay at Forbidden Door but remains in good standing with the company and expected back soon. Adam Page will return to pursue other championships while honoring his vow never to challenge for the AEW World Championship again.

stories.title: Brute Forcz’s Jammer Talks New Single “Factory of Death”, Recalls Training with Kevin Nash, GWF’s Rise and Fall, Ava Devine, Invader #1/Bruiser Brody, more
stories.tldr: Jammer of the metal band Brute Forcz discussed their new single "Factory of Death," which addresses Holocaust atrocities, and recalled their wrestling career including training with Kevin Nash, their time in the Global Wrestling Federation, and work across multiple territories before transitioning to music full-time.

stories.title: Backstage News On Kenny Omega’s Next Challenger
stories.tldr: Kevin Knight, the current AEW TNT Champion and member of the Don Callis Family, will challenge Kenny Omega for the AEW World Championship at the 2026 Redemption pay-per-view on July 26th in Montreal. MJF reportedly played a significant role in orchestrating this title match, having advocated for Knight to face Omega since losing the world title to him. Knight previously challenged MJF for the world championship in March and has been on an upward trajectory, capturing the TNT title at Dynasty before turning heel and aligning with the Don Callis Family.

stories.title: Eric Bischoff Says Vince Russo Is “Dangerous” Because He Believes His Own Lies
stories.tldr: Eric Bischoff has criticized Vince Russo for "believing his own lies" while responding to competing accounts of TNA's history presented in Dark Side of the Ring. Bischoff declined to participate in the documentary, accusing those involved of attempting to rehabilitate their reputations at the expense of others, including the deceased. He specifically objected to posthumous criticism directed at Hulk Hogan and dismissed Russo as not worth his time.

stories.title: AEW's Samoa Joe On Why He Wrestled Infamous 2005 Match: 'I Was Trying To Get Some A**'
stories.tldr: Samoa Joe recently revealed on "Dark Side of the Ring" that he took a famous 2005 independent wrestling match against Necro Butcher primarily to visit his then-girlfriend who lived near Philadelphia, joking that he was "trying to get some a**." His girlfriend attended the match but walked out early due to its graphic nature, specifically when Joe began hitting Necro so hard that blood flew into the crowd.

stories.title: Daily Update: WWE Radio, Eddie Kingston, Kevin Knight
stories.tldr: WWE has partnered with SiriusXM to launch WWE Radio starting July 27, integrating existing shows like Busted Open Radio with new WWE content including live TV simulcasts and original programming. The update also covers various wrestling news including Dragon Lee's championship aspirations, Mike Santana's NXT arrival, and other industry developments.

stories.title: AEW Talent Don’t Know If They’re Booked for Collision Until Dynamite
stories.tldr: Multiple AEW wrestlers reportedly don't learn if they're booked for Collision until Dynamite is already taping, with some discovering their status only after the Dynamite lineup is finalized. While top stars have long-term plans, mid-card talent often arrive at television without knowing if they'll work the second show, contrasting sharply with the company's early planning practices.

stories.title: AEW name pulled from WrestleCon due to Stardom commitments, former Zelina Vega added
stories.tldr: Julia Hart has been pulled from WrestleCon Minneapolis due to Stardom commitments, where she will compete in the 5 Star Grand Prix tournament on August 1. Former WWE star Thea Trinidad, who performed as Zelina Vega, has been added to the convention lineup for July 31 and August 1 following her April release from WWE.

stories.title: Jim Ross Says Vince McMahon Could Buy TNA or Another Wrestling Company
stories.tldr: Jim Ross believes Vince McMahon is unlikely to leave the wrestling business and could potentially purchase an established promotion like TNA rather than start a new company from scratch. Ross emphasized that McMahon has the financial resources and industry knowledge to make such a move, though he expects whatever McMahon does next will remain connected to wrestling in some capacity.

stories.title: Avery Styles, Son Of WWE's AJ Styles, Set For GCW Debut
stories.tldr: Avery Styles, the son of WWE's AJ Styles, is making his independent wrestling debut after training with his father. The younger Styles will debut for Game Changer Wrestling on July 31 in Omaha and August 1 in Minneapolis, with a tag team match against The Good Brothers scheduled for July 26 in Knoxville.

stories.title: Released WWE Stars To Join TNA Wrestling
stories.tldr: Several recently released WWE wrestlers are being speculated as potential signings for TNA Wrestling, including The Motor City Machine Guns, Zoey Stark, Dexter Lumis, Jeff Cobb, Bo Dallas, Dakota Kai, and Aleister Black with Zelina Vega. Many of these performers have previous history with TNA, making them logical fits for the promotion as they seek to strengthen their roster across both men's and women's divisions.

stories.title: John Cena’s Success Led To Former WWE Champion’s Decision To Leave
stories.tldr: Batista has revealed that John Cena's position as WWE's primary focus for film and entertainment opportunities, combined with WWE's shift to PG programming that didn't suit his image, led him to leave the company. When WWE refused to let him pursue outside projects, he allowed his contract to expire and eventually departed, only returning after landing a role in Guardians of the Galaxy.

stories.title: AEW Redemption injury leads to new gimmick matches
stories.tldr: AEW's inaugural Redemption pay-per-view on July 26 in Montreal has added two new gimmick matches to its card. A six-way ladder match for an International Championship shot was created after lucha libre star Mistico suffered injuries at Arena Mexico and was not cleared to compete. Additionally, a double chain tag team match between the Bang Bang Gang and The Dogs was made official following escalating tensions between the two factions on Dynamite.

stories.title: AEW Dynamite July 22 episode coverage
stories.tldr: AEW Dynamite on July 22, 2026 drew 786,000 viewers with a 0.15 demographic rating, capitalizing on the previous week's Beach Break special. The show featured two title defenses including Kevin Knight's tenth successful TNT Championship defense against Darby Allin, a Women's Tag Team Championship match with an accidental weapon injury, and a heated confrontation between Willow Nightingale and Women's Champion Thekla moderated by Mick Foley ahead of the Redemption PPV.

stories.title: Jim Ross AEW return and brain surgery
stories.tldr: Jim Ross, the 74-year-old WWE Hall of Famer and current AEW commentator, is scheduled for brain surgery in August to address memory issues and recent falls caused by fluid pressing on his brain. Despite the procedure, Ross is optimistic and has set his sights on returning to AEW commentary at All In 2026 at Wembley Stadium on August 30, though he will miss AEW Redemption this weekend. He remains committed to making fan appearances and working as long as his health allows.

stories.title: AEW All In London Wembley plans
stories.tldr: AEW has announced the "Welcome to Wembley" fan experience taking place Friday, August 28 and Saturday, August 29 at Wembley Stadium's Great Hall ahead of All In: London on August 30. The limited-capacity fan fest will feature photo opportunities with AEW wrestlers and the World Championship belt, exclusive merchandise, partner activations, and a preview scene from the upcoming AEW musical "The Last Match." Tickets priced at €60 go on sale July 24 at 10 AM BST, with early access available for AEW Insiders.

stories.title: Sting ALS Ice Bucket Challenge
stories.tldr: Sting participated in the ALS Ice Bucket Challenge on July 22, 2026, in full Crow face paint to support AEW wrestler Rebel, who was recently diagnosed with ALS. The Icon made the challenge entertaining with characteristic humor, including a reference to the infamous "December 1997 tan" controversy surrounding his Starrcade match with Hulk Hogan. He nominated Darby Allin, Tony Khan, Mick Foley, Dustin Rhodes, and his sons to continue the challenge.

stories.title: Mick Foley AEW presence
stories.tldr: Tony Khan announced that Mick Foley, who signed with AEW in May, will become a more regular presence on the company's programming going forward, though not necessarily every single week. Foley has made two notable appearances so far at Double or Nothing and Beach Break, and Khan praised his experience, positivity, and unique perspective he brings to the locker room. The company is exploring various roles for Foley including special guest correspondent, interviewer, and commentary, with the eventual goal being one final match in an AEW ring once his existing schedule commitments clear up.

stories.title: AEW Collision ladder match qualifiers
stories.tldr: AEW has announced two qualifying matches for a six-way ladder match at Redemption that will determine the number one contender for the International Championship. Lio Rush faces El Clon and Nick Wayne takes on AR Fox in the qualifying bouts on the July 25 episode of Collision, with the winners joining Jack Perry, Beast Mortos, Komander, and "Speedball" Mike Bailey in the ladder match.

stories.title: AEW vs WWE scheduling competition
stories.tldr: WWE scheduled its Worlds Collide event on September 26 in the Chicago area on the same day as AEW All Out, creating direct competition. AEW President Tony Khan responded by calling it the "predatory nature of scheduling events" while also viewing it as a compliment to AEW's success and accepting it as the reality of modern wrestling business.

stories.title: AEW Hall of Fame discussion
stories.tldr: Tony Khan expressed interest in reviving the Ring of Honor Hall of Fame and potentially creating an AEW Hall of Fame during a recent podcast appearance. While no timeline has been set, Khan acknowledged that worthy candidates exist for both halls, including current ROH Women's World Champion Athena, and confirmed he is seriously considering both projects.

stories.title: Mike Bailey AEW struggles and career
stories.tldr: Mike Bailey revealed in a recent interview that he faced a five-year US work visa ban in 2015 that nearly made him quit professional wrestling after a breakout year on the independent scene. Unable to work for major American promotions, Bailey maintained his passion for wrestling and built momentum through Japan, Europe, and Mexico before eventually signing with a major US company once his ban expired. He later joined AEW in 2025 after parting ways with TNA Wrestling in 2024.

stories.title: Chris Jericho Painmaker return
stories.tldr: Chris Jericho is bringing back The Painmaker character for his No Holds Barred rematch against Tommaso Ciampa at AEW Redemption on July 26 in Montreal. The rivalry intensified after Ciampa defeated Jericho at Beach Break and attacked him with a steel chair and power drill. AEW released a bloody vignette showing Jericho's violent alter ego in response to the brutal assault.

stories.title: Willow Nightingale AEW championship match
stories.tldr: Willow Nightingale warned AEW Women's World Champion Thekla that she's willing to embrace hardcore tactics reminiscent of Mick Foley to win the title at AEW Redemption. During a July 22 Dynamite segment moderated by Foley himself, Thekla attacked Nightingale with a microphone, but Nightingale responded with a devastating Pounce. The winner will face Mercedes Moné at AEW All In, raising the stakes significantly.

stories.title: AEW Divine Dominion tag team match
stories.tldr: The Divine Dominion retained their AEW Women's Tag Team Championships in a no disqualification match against Triangle of Madness (Julia Hart and Skye Blue) on AEW Dynamite. The match was brutal and bloody, featuring kendo sticks, chairs, tables, and both teams' championship belts as weapons. Megan Bayne and Lena Kross secured victory with a double power bomb on Hart.

stories.title: Kevin Knight AEW TNT Championship
stories.tldr: AEW TNT Champion Kevin Knight defeated former AEW World Champion Darby Allin on the July 22 episode of Dynamite to move closer to making history with his 10th successful title defense. Knight won the match controversially by using his title belt as a weapon after Darby had countered an earlier attempted belt shot with a Scorpion Death Drop. The victory sets Knight up for an AEW World Championship match against Kenny Omega at AEW Redemption 2026.

stories.title: AEW Grand Slam Mexico MJF
stories.tldr: MJF has been removed from the promotional poster for AEW Grand Slam: Mexico following his loss of the AEW World Championship to Kenny Omega on Dynamite. The poster update, released July 22, now features Omega as the face of the company ahead of the August 5 event. Reports indicate MJF is expected to take time away from AEW television after his title loss, though his involvement with All In at Wembley is still anticipated.

stories.title: Mike Santana WWE NXT debut
stories.tldr: Mike Santana made his surprise WWE NXT debut on July 21, 2026, confronting NXT Champion Tony D'Angelo after his title defense. WWE initially avoided using his name on TV due to pending trademark issues, though the company used it on social media the next day. TNA Wrestling publicly congratulated Santana on his departure, and former rival Nic Nemeth predicted he could "run" the NXT brand.

stories.title: Alexa Bliss WWE arm injury updates
stories.tldr: Alexa Bliss suffered an arm injury during a July 10 SmackDown attack by Jade Cargill, who trapped her arm in a steel chair and hyperextended her elbow. Bliss revealed she has a possible bone chip and an overstretched ligament but remains optimistic about a recovery timeline of a couple of weeks. Her status for SummerSlam remains uncertain as it depends on her healing progress and WWE's creative plans.

stories.title: Janel Grant lawsuit and personal struggles
stories.tldr: Janel Grant, who filed a lawsuit against Vince McMahon and WWE in January 2024 alleging sexual assault, sex trafficking, and abuse, broke her silence on Instagram this week following news that her case is moving to private arbitration instead of continuing in federal court. Grant shared that she has been struggling through "a perfect storm" of personal challenges but expressed gratitude for the support she has received, noting that meaningful exchanges with others have helped her feel less alone. Despite revealing she has only been outside five times this year, Grant remains committed to moving forward and "showing up to be part of the solution."

stories.title: Xavier Woods WWE release and time off
stories.tldr: Xavier Woods, known as Austin Creed, was released by WWE in May 2026 alongside tag team partner Kofi Kingston after both rejected proposed salary changes. Following his 16-year tenure with the company, Creed is currently enjoying his first extended break from professional wrestling in 22 years, spending time with family and relaxing while remaining coy about his future plans.

stories.title: WWE trademark filings updates
stories.tldr: WWE has filed a trademark for "Alix Brooks" as the official ring name for Meghan Walker, a former NIL athlete who was previously assigned the name Kylee Quinn just weeks earlier. The rapid change was made due to the similarity between "Kylee Quinn" and adult film actress Kylie Quinn, which could have caused confusion and unwanted search results. The company continues its recent pattern of active trademark filings, which also includes names for Baron Corbin's returned "Nomad" persona and other new and established talent.

stories.title: Zelina Vega post-WWE ring name
